Version History

Sign In to Save Save View source
  • History
  • Purge
  • Talk (0)

Throughout the course of time, Supercell has introduced updates to Clash Royale that fix bugs, balance battles, introduce new Cards and create new game mechanics.

November (11) 2026

Pass Royale and more (2/11/2026)

King vs King (Season 89)

  • 2 New Tower Skins: Champion Cannon Tower Skin and Competitive for All Tower Skin
  • Many other Emotes will be available. These are: Barbarian Siuuu, Evo Giant Belt, Evo Giant Trophy Spin, Goblin Can't Hear, Goblin Medal Chew, Goblin My Precious, Goblin Surrender, King Cheer Up, King GG Clap, King Treasure, Mini Pekka Cinema, Evo Mirror Shattered Ego, and Evo Mirror Victory Wishing
  • Banner Items: Winner, Fight for the Title, Evo Mirror, Evergreen Team, Baby'll Grow Up, The Fan King, Kiss the Cup, Valiant Team, Evo Giant Strike, Prince Smash, Competitive for All 1st, Competitive for All 2nd, Competitive for All 3rd, Book of Clash Vol 8 - 1, Book of Clash Vol 8 - 2, Book of Clash Vol 8 - 3, and Book of Clash Vol 8 - 4

Card Modifiers

  • 2 New Evolutions: Giant and Mirror
  • Level Boosts:
    • Giant and Mirror (Full Season)
    • Battle Ram, Hog Rider, Mortar, Minion Giant, and Goblin Barrel (9/11/2026 - 16/11/2026)
    • Royal Hogs, Three Musketeers, Royal Giant, and Ram Rider (16/11/2026 - 23/11/2026)
    • Skeleton Barrel, Golem, Electro Giant, and Lava Hound (23/11/2026 - 30/11/2026)
    • X-Bow, Miner, Graveyard, and Goblin Drill (30/11/2026 - 7/12/2026)

Other Changes

  • The King of Cards Siege & Chip Challenge, King of Cards Quick Wit Challenge, and King of Cards Beatdown Challenge have been added for a limited time
  • A new limited Royal Market event features Season 89 items including the Evo Mirror by spending Crown Tokens
    • Crown Tokens can be earned by participating in the King of Cards event, which involves winning 5 battles with specific win conditions with a reward of 275 tokens.

October (10) 2026

Balance Changes (5/10/2026)

  • Barbarian Barrel: Damage decreased to 215 (from 232)
  • Skeletons: Spawn Radius decreased to 0.53 tiles (from 0.74)
  • Evo Cannon: Barrage Damage decreased to 261 (from 281)
  • Hero Ice Wizard: Ability Damage decreased to 46 (from 89)
  • Ram Rider: Damage increased to 271 (from 250)
  • Goblin Barrel: First Hit Time increased to 0.3sec (from 0.4)
  • Lava Hound:
    • Damage increased to 71 (from 53)
    • Hit Speed decreased to 1 hit every 1.5sec (from 1.3)
  • X-Bow: Damage increased to 61 (from 58)
  • Wall Breakers: Damage increased to 302 (from 281)
  • Goblin Drill: Tower Damage increased to 20 (from 0)
  • Golden Knight:
    • Damage increased to 168 (from 161)
    • Dash Distance decreased to 5.0 (from 5.5)
  • Royal Ghost:
    • Hit Points decreased to 1152 (from 1210)
    • Damage increased to 263 (from 261)
  • Minion Giant: Hit Speed decreased to 1 hit every 1.7sec (from 1.5)
  • Elixir Collector:
    • Lifetime increased to 110sec (from 93)
    • Elixir Speed decreased to 1 every 15sec (from 13)
  • Three Musketeers: Hit Points increased to 906 (from 883)
  • Monk: Activation Time decreased to 0.7s (from 0.9)
  • Evo Elite Barbarians: Sight Range increased to 6.0 tiles (from 4.5)

Pass Royale and more (5/10/2026)

Shocktober (Season 88)

  • 2 New Tower Skins: Shocktober Tower Skin and Radio Tower Skin
  • Many other Emotes will be available. These are: Evo Electro Giant Curious Peek, Evo Electro Giant Evil Glasses, Evo Electro Giant King of the Party, Evo Electro Giant Shocked, Hero Electro Wizard Electro Rocking, Hero Electro Wizard Mad Genius, Hero Electro Wizard Nose Electrocution, Hero Electro Wizard Unlimited Power, Executioner Here's Johnny, and Royal Ghost Wassup. The Goblin CRL26 20-Win emote is only accessible after winning 20 times in the CRL 20-Win Challenge. Likewise, the Princess Tournament emote is only obtained by winning first place in an official custom creator tournament with at least 100 participants.
  • Banner Items: Bats and Storm, Electric Chair, Electro Combo, Electro Duo, Electro Wizard Cartoon, EGiant Lower Glasses, It's Alive, Popcorn, and Wizard Fury

Card Modifiers

  • New Evolution: Electro Giant
  • New Hero: Electro Wizard
  • Level Boosts: Electro Wizard, Electro Giant, Electro Spirit and Goblinstein

September (9) 2026

Balance Changes (17/9/2026)

  • Hero Ice Wizard: Freeze Duration decreased to 5sec (from 7)
  • Goblinstein: Ability duration decreased to 3.5sec (from 4)
  • Minion Giant: Damage -11%
  • Fire Spirit: Damage +4%

Balance Changes (8/9/2026)

  • Evo Elite Barbarians:
    • Rage Durations decreased to 2sec (from 2.5)
    • Spear range changed to 3-4.5 (from 3.5-5.0)
  • Battle Ram: Sight Range increased to 6.5 tiles (from 5.5)
  • Evo Battle Ram: Pushback decreased to 2 tiles (from 2.5)
  • Hero Balloon: Ability landing damage -13%
  • Ice Golem:
    • HP -7%
    • Slowdown duration increased to 2.5sec (from 2)
  • Freeze: Duration decreased to 3.5sec (from 4)
  • Fireball: Tower Damage -8%
  • Zappies: Hit speed increased to 2.3sec (from 2.2)
  • Ronin: Hit speed decreased to 1.3sec (from 1.4)
  • Goblin Cage: Brawler HP +4%
  • Spirit Empress: Damage +4%
  • Bomber: Damage -6%
  • Evo Bomber: Bounce Distance increased to 3 tiles (from 2.5)
  • Wizard:
    • Damage +8%
    • First hit speed increased to 0.5sec (from 0.4)
  • Evo Wizard: Shieid hp -8%
  • Hero Wizard: Ability Duration decreased to 3.5sec (from 5)
  • Hero Mega Minion:
    • Now teleports to original position after kill or 3.5sec
    • Ability Damage +6%
    • Now deals full damage to tower after teleport (from 25%)
  • Golem: Sight range increased to 7.5 tiles (from 7)

Merge Tactics

  • Grand Warden: Quest Objective decreased to 2/8/16 (from 3/10/20)
  • Royale King: First and Second quest objective decreased to 1/2 (from 2/3)
  • Spirit Empress: Second Quest Objective increased to 25 (from 20)
  • Barbarian: Hit Requirement decreased to 6/5/4/3 (from 8/7/6/5)
  • Archer: Hit Requirement decreased to 6/5/4/3 (from 8/7/6/5)
  • Dart Goblin: Hit Requirement decreased to 6/5/4/3 (from 8/7/6/5)
  • Valkyrie: Hit Requirement decreased to 6/5/4/3 (from 8/7/6/5)
  • Baby Dragon: Bonus hit and movement speed decreased to 6/12/25/50 (from 10/20/30/60)
  • Dark Prince: HP -15%
  • Hog Rider:
    • HP -20%
    • Earthquale damage decreased
  • Clan: Hit Speed decreased to +15/30/60% (from 30/50/100)
  • Undead: 6/6 bonus decreased to 4 (from 6)
  • Rider: 1 2 and 3 bonus decreased to 15/30/100 (from 30/60/120)

Pass Royale and more (7/9/2026)

Minion Academy (Season 87)

  • New Tower Skin: Minion Academy Tower Skin. Another one (Minion Giant) can be found in the albome event.
  • New Exclusive Emote: Ice Wizard Salt Snow. Many other Emotes will be available. These are: Elixir Loong Celebration, Hog Rider Confused, Ice Wizard Browsing, Ice Wizard Dance, King Absolute Cinema, Minion Giant Arm Fart, Minion Giant Burp, Minion Giant Spank, Minion Giant Spit and Minion Giant Unfit
  • Arena: Minion Academy Arena
  • Banner Item: minion academy! Around 18 other Banner items will be available.

Card Modifiers

  • 1 New Cards: Minion Giant
  • 1 New Heroes: Ice Wizard
  • Level Boosts: Minions, Minion Horde, Mega Minion and Ice Wizard.

Merge Tactics Seasonal Update (7/9/2026)

Troops and Traits

  • New trait: Rider: Tiles Riders touch are awakened, granting tiled allies bonus Hit and Movement Speed.
  • New 5-Golden Elixir troops: Hog Rider, Dark Prince and Ram Rider (all Rider)
  • Prince got changed to Rider (from Noble).
  • These troops are super troops, costing 5 elixir. But they do have an ability once the requirements are meet. You get assined one at the start, and thats the only troop that will appear in the shop.
  • Wizard, Goblin, Skeleton Dragon, Executioner, Mini P.E.K.K.A., P.E.K.K.A, Mega Knight, Monk, Electro Giant and Electro Wizard are removed.
  • Boss and Electric got removed.
  • Orb exclusive troops are removed. All troops (besides the other super) can appear in the shop.
  • Hitpoints and Damage scall is now fixed depending on the elixir (compared to each troop having there on). These are: 2-elixir with x1.5, 3-elixir with x1.6, 4 elixir with x1.7 and 5-elixir with x1.8.

Other Changes

  • The trophy road is now 3 months instread of 1. Because of this Diamond league will move up to 4,000 (from 3,000). Silver IV, Gold IV and Gold V is added.
  • Royale King, Elixir Loong, Battle Machine and Dagger Duchess returns as the secondary ruler.
  • You start the game with one 5-elixir troop (from 2-elixir).
  • The Quest orb got changed.
    • Quest 1 now has both 3 elixir and 1 equepment (Maiden's shield, Prince's lance, Fisherman's hook, Valkyrie's axe, Lumberjack's jar, Battle Healer's blessing, P.E.K.K.A's sword or Archer Queen's cape)
    • Quest 2 now has both 6 elixir and 1 equipment (Undead drum, Goblin lute, Noble trumpet, Forest flute, Clan horn, Rider emblem, Assassin blade, Juggernaut armor, Ranger croosbow, Superstar ring, Controller enchantment, Dragon scale, Mage wand, Thrower teleskope, Legendary lance, Legendary axe or Legendary shield)
    • Quest 3 now has both +1 team size and 1 3-star troop (Goblin Machine, Skeleton King, Golden Knight, Archer Queen, Boss Bandit, Prince, Hog Rider, Dark Prince or Ram Rider)
  • New Modifiers:
    • Merge Training: Gain a 5-Elixir Orb after your 1st, 5th, and 10th merge
    • Trait Training: Combat Start: Gain a 5/10/20-Elixir Orb the first time any Trait reaches tier 2/3/4
    • Trade Training: Gain a 5-Elixir Orb each time you sell a 2-Star troop (Max: 3)
    • Equipment Training: Gain an Orb containing a random Equipment
    • Tile Training: Each round, a Jump Tile appears at a random spot on your side. Combat Start: Tiled troop leaps to the opponent's backline
    • Building Training: Gain an Orb containing a random 2-Star building
    • Royale River: River tiled troops recover +3% of their max HP every 1s. Destroy a Princess Dummy to gain +1 Elixir, or the King Dummy to gain +2 Elixir and knock out all enemy troops!
    • Merge Mini: Your Shop only offers 5 troops. Deployed troops are locked in place until merged

Balance Changes

  • Clan:
    • Now appplies to everyone (from only clan)
    • Effect changed to HP below 50%: Allies recover HP and gain bonus Hit Speed for 3s (1x per round). 30%/50%/100% HP Recovery, +30/50/100% Hit Speed
  • Noble:
    • Now appplies to everyone (from only noble)
    • Effect changed to +15/30/60% damage (from +20/50/100% damage), -15/30/60% damage taken (from -10/25/50% damage taken)
  • Forest:
    • Now appplies to everyone (from only Forest)
    • Effect decreased to Hit Speed every 4.5/3.5/2.5sec (from 5/4/3sec)
  • Undead: Now appplies to everyone (from only undead)
  • Echo Sage:
    • Echo now deals splash damage at all levels (from only 4-star)
    • Echo now goes away after 1 attack
    • Echo now levels up after 2/4/8 kills (from 1/3/7)
    • Ruler Quest requerment increased to 2/4/8 (from 1/3/7)
  • Prince:
    • Elixir cost increased to 5 (from 3)
    • Hitpoint and damage buff, while changing the scalling to x1.8
    • Hit speed decreased to 1.42 (from 1.66)
    • Movement speed increased to fast (from medium)
  • Barbarian:
    • New ability: After a few hits, he gains bonus Hit and Movement Speed for the rest of the round
    • Hitpoints and damage decreased, while changing the scalling to x1.5
    • Hit speed decreased to 1.11 (from 1.25)
  • Archer:
    • New ability: After a few hits, her arrows deal bonus damage for the rest of the round
    • Hitpoints and damage changed, while changing the scalling to x1.5
    • Hit speed decreased to 1.11 (from 1.25)
    • Range decreased to 3 (from 4)
    • Movement speed decreased to very slow (from medium)
  • Valkyrie:
    • New ability: After a few hits, she starts spinning and damages surrounding enemies for the rest of the round
    • Hitpoints and damage decreased, while changing the scalling to x1.6
    • Hit speed decreased to 1.42 (from 2.00)
    • Movement speed decreased to very slow (from medium)
  • Knight:
    • New ability: Every few seconds, taunts all enemies in range, forcing them to attack him for 2s
    • Hitpoints decreased and damage changed, while changing the scalling to x1.5
    • Hit speed decreased to 1.42 (from 1.66)
    • Movement speed decreased to very slow (from medium)
  • Musketeer:
    • Ability changed: Combat Start: Snipes the farthest enemy in a 6-Hex Radius 3x, dealing bonus damage and briefly stunning target
    • Hitpoints and damage decreased, while changing the scalling to x1.6
    • Movement speed decreased to very slow (from medium)
  • Princess:
    • Elixir cost decreased to 2 (from 4)
    • New ability: Fires arrows at the farthest enemy, dealing area damage. Every few hits, area damage slows enemies' Hit and Movement Speed for 3s
    • Hitpoints and damage decreased, while changing the scalling to x1.5
    • Hit speed decreased to 1.42 (from 2.50)
    • Movement speed decreased to very slow (from medium)
  • Royal Giant:
    • New ability: Every few hits, he knocks surrounding enemies back 1 Hex
    • Hitpoints and damage decreased, while changing the scalling to x1.6
  • Spear Goblin:
    • New ability: Sells for bonus Elixir, increasing with Merge Level
    • Hitpoints changed and damage decreased, while changing the scalling to x1.5
    • Hit speed decreased to 1.42 (from 1.66)
  • Dart Goblin:
    • Elixir cost decreased to 2 (from 3)
    • New ability: After a few hits, every dart poisons its target, dealing damage over time based on their max HP (stacks up to 5x)
    • Hitpoints changed and damage decreased, while changing the scalling to x1.5
    • Hit speed decreased to 0.83 (from 0.9)
    • Movement speed increased to fast (from medium)
  • Goblin Cage:
    • Elixir cost decreased to 3 (from 4)
    • New ability: Cages the nearest enemy, dealing damage over time while losing HP itself. When destroyed, the enemy and a Goblin Brawler are released into the Arena
    • Hitpoints changed, while changing the scalling to x1.6
    • Movement speed decreased to very slow (from medium)
  • Bomber:
    • New ability: Throws a bomb that explodes in a 2-Hex Radius. Every few hits, the bomb bounces onward, dealing damage on each landing
    • Hitpoints and damage changed, while changing the scalling to x1.5
    • Damage radius increased to 2 hex (from 1 hex)
    • Range decreased to 2 (from 3)
    • Movement speed decreased to very slow (from medium)
  • Baby Dragon:
    • Elixir cost decreased to 3 (from 4)
    • New ability: Burps fireballs that deal area damage. Each attack grants bonus Hit and Movement Speed to allies within 2 Hexes
    • Hitpoints and damage decreased, while changing the scalling to x1.6
    • Hit speed decreased to 1.42 (from 1.66)
  • Royal Ghost
    • Elixir cost decreased to 2 (from 3)
    • Hitpoints and damage decreased, while changing the scalling to x1.5
    • Hit speed decreased to 1.11 (from 1.42)
  • Magic Archer:
    • Elixir cost decreased to 2 (from 3)
    • Hitpoints and damage decreased, while changing the scalling to x1.5
    • Hit speed decreased to 0.90 (from 1.25)
  • Firecracker:
    • Hitpoints increase and damage decreased, while changing the scalling to x1.5
    • Movement speed decreased to very slow (from medium)
  • Giant:
    • Elixir cost decreased to 3 (from 4)
    • Hitpoints decreased and damage changed, while changing the scalling to x1.6
  • Witch:
    • Elixir cost decreased to 3 (from 4)
    • Hitpoints and damage decreased, while changing the scalling to x1.6
    • Hit speed decreased to 1.42 (from 1.66)
    • Movement speed decreased to very slow (from medium)
  • Bandit
    • Elixir cost decreased to 3 (from 4)
    • Hitpoints and damage decreased, while changing the scalling to x1.6
  • Giant Skeleton: Hitpoints decreased and damage increased, while changing the scalling to x1.6
  • Goblin Demolisher:
    • Hitpoints decreased and damage changed, while changing the scalling to x1.6
    • Hit speed decreased to 1.42 (from 1.66)
  • Goblin Machine:
    • Hit Requirement changed to 4/3/2/1 (from 3/2/1/1)
    • Rocket amount changed to 2/3/4/6 (from 1/2/3/6)
    • Hitpoints changed and damage increased, while changing the scalling to x1.7
    • Hit speed increased to 1.42 (from 1.25)
  • Skeleton King:
    • Elixir cost decreased to 4 (from 5)
    • Hitpoints and damage decreased, while changing the scalling to x1.7
    • Hit speed decreased to 1.42 (from 2.00)
  • Golden Knight:
    • Elixir cost decreased to 4 (from 5)
    • Hitpoints and damage decreased, while changing the scalling to x1.7
    • Hit speed increased to 1.42 (from 1.25)
  • Archer Queen:
    • Elixir cost decreased to 4 (from 5)
    • Hitpoints changed and damage increased, while changing the scalling to x1.7
    • Movement speed decreased to very slow (from medium)
  • Boss Bandit/Merge Tactics:
    • Elixir cost decreased to 4 (from 5)
    • Hitpoints and damage decreased, while changing the scalling to x1.7
    • Hit speed changed to 1.11 (from 1.25/0.62)
    • Movement speed decreased to very slow (from medium)

August (8) 2026

Balance Changes (26/8/2026)

  • Hero Berserker: Ability Duration decreased to 3.5sec (from 4.0)
  • Evo Elite Barbarians:
    • Ability Damage -23%
    • Rage Duration decreased to 2.5sec (from 3.5)
  • Goblinstein: Monster HP -6%.
  • Electro Spirit: Chain Range decreased to 3 (from 4)
  • Archer Queen: Damage +3%
  • Little Prince: Charge Damage +25%
  • Electro Giant: Damage +13%
  • Void: Hit speed decreased to 1.0sec (from 1.2)
  • Poison and Evo Wall Breakers explosion now deals correct tower damage
  • Hero Magic Archer tripple shot now deals correct damge

Balance Changes (4/8/2026)

  • Ice Spirit, Electro Spirit, Fire Spirit, and Heal Spirit: Hitpoints -6%
  • Champions and Heroes (minus Boss Bandit): Will no longer have multi-use abilities. Instead, they will be single use
  • Little Prince:
    • Little Prince will now maintain his charged-up Hit Speed for up to 0.3 seconds while moving
    • Guardian Melee Damage +7%
  • Goblinstein:
    • Doctor Damage +47%
    • Ability DPS -12%
  • Mighty Miner: Base Damage +8%
  • Evo Witch:
    • Heal per Skeleton +189%
    • Max HP +40%
    • Overheal Ratio +40%
    • She can now only be healed by the first 4 Skeletons
  • Battle Healer:
    • Damage +81%
    • Hit Speed increased to 2s (from 1.5s)
    • DPS +35%
    • Heal per Second -25%
    • Heal Radius -25%
    • Heal Area -44%
    • No longer heals herself. She will also not be able to heal other Battle Healers
  • Void:
    • Elixir Cost increased to 5 (from 3)
    • Hit Speed increased to 1.2s (from 1s)
    • 1 Target Damage +105%
    • 2-4 Target Damage +83%
    • 5+ Target Damage +101%
    • 1 Target Tower Damage +102%
    • 2-4 Target Tower Damage +104%
    • 5+ Target Tower Damage +106%
  • Goblin Curse: A Slowdown Effect is now being added into the spell
  • Goblin Machine:
    • Rocket Hit Speed increased to 5s (from 3.5s)
    • Rocket Speed +40%
    • Melee Damage +9%
    • Hitpoints +5%
  • Rune Giant:
    • Hitpoints +6%

May (5) 2026

2026 Q2 Update (26/5/2026)

Experience removed & King level

  • Experience is being removed.
  • Unlock will be at the trophy road:
    • Clan unlock at arena 1 (from level 1)
    • Deck Slots unlock at arena 1 (from level 2)
    • Clan Donation unlock at arena 2 (from level 3)
    • Pass Royale unlock at arena 2 (from level 7)
    • Clan Wars unlock at arena 3 (from level 10)
    • Clan Trading unlock at arena 3 (from level 16)
    • Card Mastery unlock at arena 4 (from level 14)
    • Star Points unlock at arena 5 (from level 9)
  • King level updrage is being changed from level to having a centain amount of card at a certain card level.

King's Journey removed & collection level

  • The King's Journey is being removed
    • All unclaimed rewards will be autocollected
  • Collection Level added as a new way to earn rewards
    • Upgrade cards, and unlock heroes and evolutions to progress through the collection levels to earn rewards
    • The collection level equals the level of every card you own & +5 for every evo and hero unlocked

Mastery changes

  • All mastery task will be much easier to complete
  • All rewards are changed to only gold (giving 4.000, 6.000 and 15.000 respectfully)

Seasonal Arena

  • After 14,000 trophies, you unlock seasonal arenas
  • The first arena is normal. Unlock 500 trophies to get to arena two
  • Arena two will have the 8 cards you played the most banned. Get a badge afer getting 500 trophies.
  • All cards in arena 2 are bosted to level 15

Victory Run

  • Victory Run is a event on the home screen.
  • Win games to climb up and get rewards
  • You have 3 lives (4 with pass royale). Loss all your lives, and you can spend 10 gems, or fall down.
  • There will be checkpoints. But the distance will be further, the higher you are.

Princess Gambit

  • Princess Gambit is a new game mode with different starting hands
  • It has a total of 40 cards (6 Spells, 4 Win Conditions, 4 Heavy Cards, 2 Buildings and 24 Support Cards)
  • There are no decks. You just get the 40 cards in your hand at random
  • The start of the match will show the active evolutions and heroes. Evolutions has 0 cycles
  • There is no King Tower, and its all in Sudden Death

Other Changes

  • if you stop playing for a while, the daily rewards will be better
  • You can now spectate Global Tournaments
  • You can now favourite Battle Banners. This is the same as emotes, as they will appear at the top.
  • You can now skip tiers in pass royale. 10gems per crown
  • If you buy Pass Royale multiple times in a row, you may gain a bonus reward
    • Do note that this is in testing, and not necessarily be available for all players.
  • Mini Pass is being added to the game. Its like pass royale, but cheaper, shorter and less rewards. Free to play can still get some rewards.
    • Do note that this is in testing, and not necessarily be available for all players.
  • Other minor bug fixes and improvements

    • Abyss Tile: Combat Start: Troop that steps on this tile is instantly destroyed and the tile disappears (Bronze III).

    • Mine Tile: Combat Start: Mine Tile explodes after 5s, dealing AoE damage to nearby trooops (Silver I).
    • Goblin's Treasure: Combat Start: Goblin's Treasure appears on both sides. Destroy the enemy's to gain a Loot Orb! (Silver II).

    • One Life to Live: Gain +2 Elixir per round. Troops retain their HP between rounds and will disappear once defeated (Silver III).

    • Equalization: All troops cost 3 Elixir (Gold II).

    • Bonus Damage increased by 33%
    • Bonus Hit Speed increased by 33%

Pass Royale and more (2/3/2026)

10th Anniversary (Season 81)

  • New Tower Skin: 10th Birthday (Pass Royale). Other Tower Skins (Just Joust) will be available in the game.
  • New Exclusive Emote: Hero Barbarian Barrel Popup. Many other Emotes will be available. These are: Hero Barbarian Barrel Launch, Hero Barbarian Barrel Self Love, Goblin Cheater, King Silly Walk, Hero Magic Archer Crown Grab, Hero Magic Archer Face Palm, Hero Magic Archer Rainbow Bow and Skeleton Shield Bang
  • Arena: 10th Birthday Arena
  • Banner Item: Royale 10 Year's Celebration! Around 22 other Banner items will be available.
  • Seasonal Lucky Chest: Anniversary Lucky Chest.
  • New gamemode: C.H.A.O.S.

Card Modifiers

  • 2 New Heroes: Barbarian Barrel and Magic Archer
  • Level Boosts: Barbarian Barrel, Knight, Battle Ram and Magic Archer

Balance Changes

  • Royal Ghost: Invisibility Delay increased to 2sec (from 1.8sec)
  • Evolved Royal Hogs: Landing damage -27%
  • Vines: Deploy Time increased to 0.9 sec (from 0.4sec)
  • Hero Ice Golem: Freeze duration decreased to 1.5sec (from 2sec)
  • Royal Giant: Hit Speed increased to 1.8 sec (from 1.7sec)
  • Dart Goblin: Sigh Range decreased to 7 tiles (from 7.5)
  • Phoenix:
    • Egg Hitpoints +32%
    • Egg lifetime decreased to 3.8sec (from 4.3sec)
  • Bats: Hit speed decreased to 1.2sec (from 1.3sec)
  • Barbarians:
    • HP +3%
    • Hit speed increased to 1.4sec (from 1.3)
  • Evolved Executioner: Pushback decreased to 1 tile (from 1.5)
  • Executioner: Damage +7%
  • Evolved Electro Dragon: Chain Damage -50%
  • Electro Dragon: Hitpoints +5%
  • Spirit Empress:
    • Ground speed is increased to fast (from medium)
    • Ground hitpoints -7%
    • Air Hitpoints -1%
  • Hero Knight: Ability Radius decreased to 6.5 tiles (from 7.5)
  • Hero Mega Minion: Ability Damage -12%
  • Hero Magic Archer:
    • Decoy Hitpoints -9%
    • Ability cooldown increased to 25sec (from 20sec)

February (2) 2026

2026 Q1 Update (23/2/2026)

Progression

  • The Crystals system has felt punishing for many players, and to improve this, duplicates of Max Level cards will be reduced:
    • If you have fewer than 60 Max Level cards, you will not receive duplicates of Max Level cards.
    • If you have more than 60 Max Level cards, the drop weight of Max Level cards will be reduced by 90%.

Trophy Road & Ranked

  • The Hero unlock slot will now be available at Arena 5, bringing this feature closer to the start of your journey.
  • 4 New Arenas:
    • Magic Academy (12,000 )
    • Ultimate Clash Pit (12,500 )
    • Little Prince's Tavern (13,000 )
    • Spirit Square (13,500 )

Socail Tab

  • The clan Tab is being rebranded into the Social Tab.
    • You can still acces clanchat and clanwar with buttons at the top
  • Here you have a list of clanmates and friend.
  • Add Friend button, where you can send a link or QR code
  • Quickplay button, to get a quick battle. You can send a link or QR code

Album Event

  • Album Event is a new kind of live event.
  • The goal is to collect snippets during the season, to unlock scenes.
  • Have a full scene to unlock a reward, where you get a bigger reward when all scenes are complete.
  • Each snipit has 4 rarities: Commen, Rare, Epic Legendary
  • Some scenes need more commens, while the later scenes need more epic and legendary snipits.
  • Duplicats will fill a meter. The higher the rarity, the more duplicates.
  • Fill the meter to get a unique snippet, that you have not unlocked

Global Tournament

  • Global Tournaments are back
  • You can now find it in the event switcher
  • The rewards are changed, and the bonus reward for 500 gems is gone
  • No dadge for reaching 15 wins, with another badge for top 1,000 players

Other changes

  • Hero Boxes are removed from the lists of unlocks of the Trophy Road and the Battle Rewards popup.
  • Hero Wizard: Tower damage -64%
  • Hero Goblins:
    • Spawned units decreased to 3 (from 4)
    • Banner duration decreased to 5sec (from 7sec)

Merge Tactics

  • Dagger Duchess added. Ruler Modifier: Dagger Donation.
  • Spirit Empress returns as the secondary ruler.
  • New troops:
    • 3-Golden Elixir: Giant (Titan and Superstar), goblin Demolisher (Goblin and Warrior).
    • Archers, Baby Dragon, Giant Skeleton and Knight comes back
    • Bandit, Electro Giant, Executioner, Mega Knight, Mini P.E.K.K.A, Princess, Royal Ghost and Spear Goblin have been removed.
  • Traits are changed:
    • Blaster, Brawler, Brutalist, P.E.K.K.A, and Ranger have been removed.
    • Dragon, Hinder, Marksman, Tank and Warrior added.
    • Giant is now renamed to Titan
  • New Modifiers:
    • Equipment: Valkyrie's Axe: Equipped troop deals AoE attack damage until Axe breaks (5 hits) (Bronze III).
    • Equipment: Fisherman's Hook: Equipped troop pulls in farthest enemy in 4 tiles until Hook breaks (1 hit) (Silver II).
    • Equipment: Prince's Lance: Equipped troop knocks enemy back 2 tiles until Lance breaks (3 hits) (Gold I).
    • Equipment: Maiden's Shield: Equipped troop is immune to damage until Shield breaks (hit 5x) (Gold III).
  • Miscellaneous changes:
    • Season Length now run 6-7 weeks (from 4 weeks)
    • You can now play with friends. 2 people can still earn rewards, while 3-4 people is friendly battle
    • The troops collection level is now visible on its hp-bar
    • Benched troops now display there stars/merge level
    • An indicater to show when the Echo Sage ability is ready
    • Ruler Cards earned beyound the cap now gives Crystals (1 card=480 crystals)
    • Card Boosts now apply to Merge Tactics
    • Crown rush now counts Merge Tactics battles.

Merge tactics Balance Changes'

  • Goblin Queen:
    • Now counts as a goblin herself
    • Goblin Drop Rate reduced to 25% (from 33%)
  • Echo Sage: Echo Level-Up HP groth decreased to 150% (from 170%)
  • Dart Goblin:
    • Elixer Cost decreased to 2 (from 3)
    • Hitpoints decreased by 57%
  • Royal Giant
    • Elixer Cost increased to 3 (from 2)
    • Hitpoints increased by 11%
    • Damage icreased by 25%
    • Hitspeed increased to 2sec (from 1.66sec)
  • P.E.K.K.A:
    • Elixir Cost increased to 4 (from 3)
    • Hitpoint increased by 17%
    • Damage increased by 6%
    • Ability can how hit multiple units in a row
  • Prince:
    • Elixir Cost increased to 4 (from 3)
    • Hitpoints increased by 37%
    • Hit Speed increased to 1.66 sec (from 1.42 sec)
  • Archer Queen:
    • Ability can now has multi-trigger
    • Damage increased by 11%
    • Hit speed is increased to 1.66 sec (from 1.25sec)
  • Ace:
    • Now only gives a damage bonus
    • 4/4 Damage Bonus increased to 100 (from 70)
  • Clan: Now gives a HP bonus (instead of healing and hit speed)
  • Titan: Now gives individual bonus
    • Giant makes surrounding troops take less damage
    • Royal Giant makes Surrounding troops deal bonus damage
  • Fire: Now gives individual bonus
    • Wizard deals stacking bonus damage per attack, up to 6×
    • Baby Dragon gives Surrounding troops bonus hit speed and movement speed
  • Noble: Adjacent placement is required for it to activate
  • Superstar:
    • 1/3 Fill rate increased to 50% (from 33%)
    • 2/3 Fill rate increased to 100% (from 67%)

Pass Royale and more (2/2/2026)

Midnight Mischief (Season 80)

  • New Tower Skin: Love Temple (Pass Royale). Other Tower Skins (Gothic Love) will be available in the game.
  • New Exclusive Emote: goblin hero peek. Many other Emotes will be available. These are: Hero Goblin Head Crush, Hero Goblin Knife, Hero Goblin Troll Face, Hero Mega Minion Gargoyle, Hero Mega Minion Ovation, Hero Mega Minion Scary and Hero Mega Minion What
  • Arena: Love Temple Arena.
  • Banner Item: Gothic Valentine. Around 10 other Banner items will be available.
  • Seasonal Lucky Chest: Valentines Lucky Chest.

Card Modifiers

  • 2 New Heroes: Goblins and Mega Minion
  • Level Boosts:
    • 2 Feb-16 Feb: Goblins and Princess
    • 16 Feb-2 Mar: Mega Minion and Zap

Merge Tactics Seasonal Update

  • Spirit Empress returns.
  • New Modifiers:
    • Merge Bonus: Merging grants 1-Star base troop. (Silver I).
    • Star Advantage: Higher-Star troops deal more damage to and take less damage from lower-Star troops. (Silver III)
    • Domination: 3 and 4-Star troop gain bonus HP and damage. (Gold II)
  • Building modifiers will now provide a 3-star building in round 5 (instead of a 2-star at round 3)
  • Tile modifiers now place two tiles (instead of one)
  • Players who finish in the top 1,000 will get a bagde with the exact position. Updating when getting a higher rank.

Balance Changes

  • Mini P.E.K.K.A: Cook Time increased from 20s to 22s
  • Witch: Heal per Skeleton decreased by 11%
  • Giant (also effects Heroic Giant): Hitpoints decreased by 3%
  • Graveyard: Improved spawn pattern and increased spawn radius from 2.9 to 3.3 tiles
  • Minions: Hit Speed increased by 9%
  • Three Musketeers: Hit Speed increased by 8%
  • Hero Wizard: Tornado Pull Strength increased by 25%
  • Evo Goblin Drill: Number of Goblins on second submerge increased to 2 (from 1)
  • Evo P.E.K.K.A: Heal per Kill from all forms increased by 5%
  • Hero Musketeer:
    • Deploy time increased to 2 seconds (from 1 second)
    • Turret Range decreased by 36%

Bug Fixes 🐛

  • Balloon: Hitpoints decreased by 1%
  • Barbarian Barrel: Damage increased by 2%

January (1) 2026

Balance Changes (12/1/2026)

  • Skeleton Barrel: Death damage decreased by 8%.
  • Musketeer: Turret deploy time increased to 2 seconds (from 1 second).
  • Mini P.E.K.K.A.: Damage healed decreased to 30% (from 40%).
  • Knight: Shield hitpoints decreased by 6%.
  • Skeleton Army:
    • Shadow Skeleton speed decreased to Medium (from Fast).
    • General spawns 1 tile higher.
  • Golden Knight: Ability cooldown increased to 12 seconds (from 8 seconds)
  • Dart Goblin (affects Evolved Dart Goblin): Damaged decreased by 8%.
  • Mini P.E.K.K.A. (affects Heroic Mini P.E.K.K.A.): Hitpoints decreased by 3%.
  • Boss Bandit:
    • HIt speed increased by 9%.
    • Normal and dash damage decreased by 9%.
  • Furnace (affects Evolved Furnace): Hit speed increased by 6%.
  • Ram Rider: Ram hit speed increased by 6%.
  • Giant Skeleton: Hit speed increased by 8%.
  • Little Prince: Damage increased by 5%.
  • Graveyard:
    • Spawn Pattern changed from being random to fixed and defined.
    • Skeleton Count increased to 14 (from 13).

Pass Royale and more (5/1/2026)

Fire and Ice (Season 79)

  • New Tower Skin: Ice and Fire (Pass Royale). Other Tower Skins (Elemental Duality, Hero Pantheon) will be available in the game.
  • New Exclusive Emote: Hero Wizard Fire. Many other Emotes will be available. These are: Firecracker Success, Goblin Pocket Watch, Hero Ice Golem Blizzard, Hero Ice Golem Rise, Hero Ice Golem Vanish, King Thumbs Down, Hero Wizard It’s Fine, Hero Wizard Magic Tricka and Hero Wizard Pyromaniac
  • Arena: Fire and Ice Arena.
  • Banner Item: Fire and Ice. Around 16 other Banner items will be available.
  • Seasonal Lucky Chest: Frostfire Lucky Chest.

Card Modifiers

  • 2 New Heroes: Wizard and Ice Golem
  • Level Boosts: Wizard, Tornado, Ice Golem and Skeletons

Merge Tactics Seasonal Update

  • Echo Sage added. Ruler Modifier: Striking Clone.
  • New Modifiers:
    • Damage Tile: Troops placed on this tile enter combat at 50% HP and deal bonus damage. (Bronze III).
    • Clone Tile: Troops placed on this tile will be cloned. The duplicate has 70% of the original's HP. (Silver II)
    • Immune Tile: The troop on this tile is indestructible for the first 5 seconds of combat. (Gold I)
    • Jump Tile: Troops placed here jump into enemy territory at battle start. (Gold III)
  • Building modifiers will now provide a 2-star building in round 3 (instead of a 1-star at round 1)

Merge Tactics Balance Changes (2/1/2026)

  • Clan: Hit Speed buff duration now expires after 5sec (from infinite)
  • Assassin:
    • Crit chance and damage for 2/4 increased to 30% (from 25%)
    • Crit chance and damage for 4/4 increased to 60% (from 45%)
  • P.E.K.K.A:
    • Heal is increased to 60% (from 30%)
    • Bonus Damage increased to 40% (from 30%)
  • Bandit:
    • Hitpoints increased by 12,5%
    • Damage increased by 12,5%
  • Witch:
    • Hitpoints increased by 20%
    • Damage increased by 25%
  • Golden Knight: Hit speed is reduced to 1.0 (from 1.25)

Past Update History

Updates to the game in 2025.

December (12) 2025

Maintenance Break (22/12/2025)

  • Summoning a Hero with 200 Hero Fragments will always grant you a Hero that you don't have yet (as opposed to having a chance to get a duplicate Hero).
  • Having all Heroes during a Hero summon will grant you 20 Hero Fragments and some card copies of that Hero.
  • Hero Mini P.E.K.K.A. added to the roster of summonable Heroes.
  • Only 1 Hero slot is available in Classic 1v1s, Classic 2v2s, Classic Challenges, and Grand Challenges.

Balance Changes (12/12/2025)

Card Balancing

  • Knight: Triumphant Taunt Duration decreased to 4 seconds (from 5 seconds).
  • Monk: immune to any knockback.

Bug Fixes

  • Goblin Demolisher: No longer chases Hero Knight during Triumphant Taunt after less than 50% Hitpoints.

Pass Royale and more (1/12/2025)

Heroic Holidays (Season 78)

  • New Tower Skin: Heroic Clashmas Tower Skin (Pass Royale). Another Tower Skin (Clashmas Heroes Temple) will be available in the game.
  • New Exclusive Emote: Hero Mini Pekka Pancake Slash. Many other Emotes will be available. These are: Goblin L Dance, Golem Sus Rock, Hero Giant Come To Me, Hero Giant Clashmas Tree Ball, Hero Knight Mustache Dance, Hero Knight Santa Dance, Hero Knight Shield Charge, Hero Mini Pekka Switch On, Hero Musketeer Blow Smoke, Hero Musketeer Fire, and X-Bow Clashmas (Crown Chase - Twelve Days of Clashmas)
  • Arena: Musketeer Street Arena.
  • Banner Item: Around 24 Banner items will be available.
  • Seasonal Lucky Chest: Gingerbread Lucky Chest.

Trophy Road & Ranked

  • 4 New Arenas:
    • Lumberlove Cabin (10,000 )
    • Royal Road (10,500 )
    • Musketeer Street (11,000 )
    • Summit of Heroes (11,500 )
  • Seasonal Arenas temporarily disabled; Ranked unlocks at 10,500 .
  • Ranked is capped at Level 15 until May 2026.

Additions

  • Magic Lucky Chests level up once the player reaches certain Arenas, with Level 16 changing its visual.
  • Hero Boxes added. They also Level up once the player reaches certain Arenas.
  • Evolution Boxes added.
  • Second Hero/Champion slot moved to Level 25.
  • Cards are now buyable with Gems.

Heroes

  • They function like Champion cards, but can only be collected once 200 are obtained from Hero Boxes.
  • The player can customize the placement of the two ability buttons (left and right, left, right).
  • The player gets a random Hero once they get 200 . If they get a Hero they already had, they will get 60 and some card copies.

Card Modifiers

  • 4 New Heroes: Knight, Giant, Mini P.E.K.K.A., and Musketeer.
  • Level Boosts: Knight, Giant, Mini P.E.K.K.A., and Musketeer.

Balance Changes Main Game

  • Barbarian Barrel:
    • Hitpoints decreased by 4%
    • Barbarian Deployment Time increased to 1 second (from 0.5 seconds).
  • Evolved Royal Ghost:
    • Souldier Damage decreased by 22%
    • Souldier Spawn Damage decreased by 22%.
  • Electro Spirit: Shock Chain Period increased to 0.25 seconds (from 0.2 seconds).
  • Evolved Baby Dragon: Allied Movement Speed Boost decreased to 30% (from 50%).
  • Evolved Valkyrie: Whirlwind Radius decreased to 5 tiles (from 5.5 tiles).
  • Evolved Cannon: Barrage Damage decreased by 8%.
  • Magic Archer: Damage increased by 8%.
  • Void: Single Target Damage increased by 6%.
  • Freeze: Damage increased by 29%.
  • Goblin Demolisher: Attack Period decreassed to 1.1 seconds (from 1.2 seconds).
  • Three Musketeers: 0.1 seconds Deploy Stagger added.

Merge Tactics

  • Musketeer:
    • Damage increased by 50%
    • Ability Target Count set to 1/2/3/4 (from 3)
    • Hit Requirement increased to 5/4/3/2 (from 4/3/2/1).
  • Witch:
    • Damage increased by 20%
    • Hitpoints increased by 15%
    • Skeleton Spawn Count decreased to 1/2/3/6 (from 1/2/4/8)
    • Skeleton Damage and Hitpoints decreased to 20% of the Witch's Damage and Hitpoints (from 50%)
    • Skeleton Spawn Period increased to 6 seconds (from 5 seconds).
  • Tesla:
    • Range increased to 2 hexes (from 1 hex)
    • now targets multiple enemies.
  • Superstar: Max Ability Re-Cast set to 4.

November (11) 2025

Maintenance Break (26/11/2025)

Merge Tactics Card Balancing:

  • Evolution Wild Shards correctly convert.
  • Evolved Giant Snowball damages Crown Towers again.
  • Level 16 Tower Princess now two-shots Lava Pups.
  • Graveyard plays its deployment sound effect again.
  • Merge Tactics merge level toggle button re-added.
  • Electro Giant's Electric Field is now correctly affected by Superstar.
  • Other small fixes.

Merge Tactics Balance Changes (24/11/2025)

  • Royale King: Royal Commission Elixir Per Loss increased to 4-8 (from 4).
  • Wizard:
    • Damage increased by 0%/12.5%/27%/42%
    • Attack Period set to 1.25 seconds (from 1.25/1.04/0.86/0.72).
  • Princess:
    • Damage decreased by 25%
    • Attack Period decreased to 2 seconds (from 2.5 seconds).
  • Skeleton King: Damage decreased by 22.22%.

Merge Tactics Seasonal Update (24/11/2025)

  • Battle Machine added. Ruler Modifier: Building Master.
  • Elixir Loong removed from Starsteel road.
  • New traits: Brutalist, Giant, P.E.K.K.A, Superstar.
  • New troops:
    • 2-Golden Elixir: Mini P.E.K.K.A. (P.E.K.K.A and Brutalist), Royal Giant (Giant and Ranger).
    • 5-Golden Elixir: Monk (Ace and Superstar).
    • Knight, Archer, Giant Skeleton, Baby Dragon, and Electro Wizard have been removed.
  • Avenger, Electric, Fire, Juggernaut, and Mage have been removed.
  • Troop and Trait changes:
    • Noble and Undead no longer have a 6-troop effect.
    • P.E.K.K.A.'s traits are P.E.K.K.A and Brawler (from Ace and Avenger).
    • Valkyrie, Goblin Machine, and Skeleton King's secondary trait is Brutalist (from Juggernaut).
    • Princess's secondary trait is Blaster (from Ranger).
    • Wizard's traits are Clan and Blaster (from Fire and Mage).
    • Electro Giant's traits are Giant and Superstar (from Electric and Avenger).
    • Archer Queen's secondary trait is Ranger (from Avenger).
    • Musketeer's secondary trait is Superstar (from Blaster).
    • Witch's secondary trait is Superstar (from Avenger).
  • New Modifiers:
    • Building: Elixir Collector: Generates Elixir over time (Bronze II).
    • Building: Tesla: Deals damage to nearby enemies, only appearing when one is in range (Silver I).
    • Building: X-Bow: Takes a while to charge, but rapid fires on the lowest HP enemy when ready (Silver III).
    • Building: Mortar: Long-range building that only deals damage to the farthest enemy (Gold II).
    • Building: Inferno Tower: Damage increases over time when attacking the same target (Diamond).
  • Miscellaneous changes:
    • Zooming in added.
    • Emotes added.
    • UI tweaks.

Level 16 Update (24/11/2025)

  • Level 16 has been added.
  • All Wild Cards, Magic Coins, Books of Cards, and Books of Books were converted into Gems, Gold, and Wild Cards of the Book's rarity.
  • Ranked level-capped at level 15 until May 2026.
  • Trophy Road rewards tweaked.
  • Evolution slots moved to Arena 3 and 10, added Hero/Champion slots to Arena 15 and 24.
  • Gold and copy requirement for Cards modified at level 13 and 14.
  • Crystals and the Crystal Market added.
  • Pass Royale now changes at Arena 15, evolving into a Hero Pass Royale. All tiers had their rewards tweaked.
  • Added deck slots exclusive to Champion cards.
  • New visual effects for a lot of cards. More specifically:
    • Certain attacks (Night Witch, Lumberjack, and Golden Knight) get new slicing attacks (Night Witch had her previous attack effect substituted).
    • Explosions (Fireball, Bomber, Bomb Tower, Balloon, Giant Skeleton, and Goblin Demolisher) have new effects.
    • Fire (Skeleton Dragons, Wizard, and Baby Dragon) has new fireball and splash effects.
    • Lightning (Electro Wizard Zappies, Electro Wizard, and Electro Dragon) has a new effect.
    • Shields (Guards, Royal Recruits, and Dark Prince) have a smaller health bar above the troop's main health bar.
    • Witch's orb and splash are cleaner.
    • Princess' arrows are no longer in flames when still on her bow, arrows disappear quicker after hitting the ground.
    • Electro Giant has a blue Zap Pack range.
    • Bandit has a new effect after hitting a target with her dash.
    • Goblin Machine has a different rocket lock-in animation.
    • Skeleton King has dark-green visual effects when summoning Skeletons.
    • Golden Knight has a slight golden flash when hitting a target with Dashing Dash and has new different poses when dashing to targets.
    • Evolutions have a new deployment visual effect to match with the newer Evolution releases.
      • Shield Visuals (Evolved Knight and Evolved Wizard) have been changed to a dark purple shield.
      • Lightning (Evolved Tesla and Evolved Electro Dragon) is now purple.
      • Explosions (Evolved Bomber, Evolved Cannon, and Evolved Wall Breakers) have purplish fire explosions. They also have purplish fire on the tip of their bomb/dynamites.
      • Shields (Evolved Wizard and Evolved Skeleton Army) have a smaller health bar above the troop's main health bar.
      • Evolved Goblin Cage now causes a purple smoke when the hand leaves the cage, grabs a troop, and attacks the grabbed troop.
      • Evolved Valkyrie's whirlwind is a clearer and cleaner purple.
      • Evolved Battle Ram leaves a purple smoke when charging and when hitting its first troop.
      • Evolved Wizard's fireball and splash are a purplish color.
      • Evolved Tesla's pulses are now a clearer purple color.
      • Evolved Mega Knight's jump now causes a small purple earthquake.
      • Evolved Goblin Drill's submerge trail is now a darker purple and spawns alongside a purple smoke.
  • Monk is no longer immune to the knockback effects of Evolved Mega Knight and another Monk. He is also no longer immune to Fireball and Giant Snowball's knockbacks if those spells hit the Monk on the corner of their Area of EFfect.

2025 Quarter 3 Update (29/9/2025)

Champion Rework

  • Champions will not bring 3-card cycle anymore: they come back to the player's cycle like any other card.
  • Only the most recent placed Champion has the ability.
    • The Champion that possesses the ability has a crown icon.
    • Cooldowns are reset when the ability is transferred between Champions.
    • Skeleton King's soul bar resets during ability transference.
  • Mirror now works on Champions.
  • There can still be only one Champion per deck.

Lucky Chests

  • Replaced Lucky Drops with Lucky Chests.
  • Lucky Chests come in 3 types:
    • Common Lucky Chests - 3 spins for Cards and Gold.
    • Magic Lucky Chests - 4 spins for Cards, Gold, Magic Items, and cosmetics.
    • Seasonal Lucky Chests - rewards and spins vary each season.

Merge Tactics

  • Seasonal Resets added: one week before seasonal resets.
  • Merge Tactics badges added for each season.
  • Goblin Queen added. Ruler Modifier: Greener Grin ("defeating an enemy troop results in a 40% chance of spawning a Goblin").
  • Elixir Loong added. Ruler Modifier: Endless Spring ("Gain +1 Elixir per round and +1 Team Size").
  • New Ruler Skins: Ghoul King, Astral Empress, Jade Queen, Chaos Queen, Malevolent Queen, Spirit Loong, Fire Loong, Aqua Loong.
  • New Ruler Confetti: Smothering Smog, Firestorm.
  • Spirit Empress can no longer be obtained by players, but can be kept by those who already had her. Players can also unlock her by purchasing Astral Empress.
  • New traits: Electric, Fire, Mage
  • Thrower renamed to Blaster.
  • Ability bars added to cards that have a cooldown/attack requirement to activate abilities.
  • New troops:
    • 2 Golden Elixir: Skeleton Dragon (Undead and Ranger), Wizard (Fire and Mage).
    • 3 Golden Elixir: Electro Giant (Electric and Avenger), Musketeer (Noble and Blaster).
    • 4 Golden Elixir: Baby Dragon (Fire and Blaster), Electro Wizard (Electric and Mage), Witch (Undead and Avenger).
    • Bomber has been removed.
  • Troop and Trait changes:
    • All troops' Hitpoints and Damage statistics have been slightly tweaked.
    • Ace troops get +20% attack speed at combat start, strongest Ace is the captain (from strongest troop in general).
    • Assassin activates at 2 and 4 troops (+25%/+50% Critical Chance and Critical Damage) from 3 (+35% Critical Chance and Critical Damage).
    • Avenger activates at 2 and 4 troops (+20%/+40% Damage) from 3 (+30%).
    • Blaster activates at 2 and 4 troops (+10%/+20% damage per distance) from 3 (+15% damage per distance).
    • Brawler gives +50%/+100% HP (from +40%/+80%) and no longer works on non-Brawler.
    • Clan no longer works on non-Clan.
    • Juggernaut Shield now prevents control effects.
    • Noble no longer works on non-Noble and activates at 2, 4, and 6 troops (20%/30%/45%) from 2 and 4 (20%/40%).
    • Ranger activates at 2 and 4 troops (+10%/+15% attack speed per hit) from 3 (+15% attack speed per hit).
    • { {Trait|Undead}} also activates at 6 troops, cursing 75% from 4 units.
    • Bandit's secondary trait is Assassin (from Avenger).
    • P.E.K.K.A.'s secondary trait is Avenger (from Juggernaut).
    • Valkyrie's secondary trait is Juggernaut (from Avenger).
    • 2 Modifiers per League instead of 3.
  • New Modifiers:
    • Elixir Festival: +2 Elixir per round (Bronze III).
    • Endurance Training: all troops gain +40% HP (Silver I).
    • Last Stand: the last troop standing gains +200% damage (Silver III).
    • Chaos Chaos: once per turn, when troops merge, they become a random troop of +1 Elixir (Gold I).
    • Master Arena: troops gain +100% HP and +50% damage if they stay on the same tile from round to round (Gold I).
    • Ultimate Origins: start with a Dummy with Undead and Noble traits (Gold III).
    • Coaching: Benched troops gain +100% damage and +50% HP next round (Diamond).
    • Monster Drink: combat start: lowest HP troop gets bigger and gains +200% HP and +100% damage (Diamond).
    • Modifiers removed: Bigger Team, Legacy, Party Time, Rare Star, Epic Star, Legendary Star, Richer and Richer, Less is More, Ouch!, First Free, Four Stars, Pandora's Bench, Just Keep Living, Huddle Up! Lucky Discount, Clear Mind, Smart Trade, First Choice.
  • Miscellaneous changes:
    • Spectating enemies no longer mirrors them.
    • Troops in the shop are now in a random order.
    • Benched troops no longer auto-deployed if team size is below max amount.
    • Amount of benched troops now visible to enemies. Exact troops are still hidden.
    • Detailed polishes to Battle Phase Transition.
    • UX/UI changes.
    • Battle-end UI Toggleable, many icons are clickable for details.
    • More Ruler animations for certain UI.
    • Elixir Collector now sellable from the "Sell" button.

Bug Fixes

  • Charging troops no longer instantly attack after charge has been interrupted.
  • Monk no longer takes increased damage from Arrows during Pensive Protection.
  • Evolved Goblin Cage no longer grabs Mega Knight mid-air.
  • Lightning and Vines take shields into consideration.
  • Improved pathfinding for Spirit Empress' Air Form.
  • Improved pathfinding for troops around destroyed buildings.
  • Classic and Grand Challenges give badges again.
  • Friends can now be seen in Trophy Road again.
  • Other improvements and performance fixes.

Other Changes

  • Each player now gets 4 Lucky Chests per day as a win reward.
  • "New Event" for New Events in the gamemode switcher.
  • Training Camp and tournaments moved to the gamemode switcher.

June (6) 2025

2025 Quarter 2 Update (30/6/2025)

New Gamemode

  • Merge Tactics is a new gamemode where 4 players face off in fast-paced battles, each building a team from classic Clash Royale Troops.
  • There are 20 cards, 2 rulers and 27 modifiers present on this game mode.

Trophy Road Changes

  • New Arena: Valkalla, at 9,000 . Legendary Arena moved to 9,500 .
  • Trophy Road rewards tweaked.
  • Starting from 7/7/2025, 5 Seasonal Arenas will be present, at 10,000, 11,000, 12,000, 13,500, and 15,000 , respectively, with different rewards. Those Arenas are the same as the special, seasonal Arenas every season and rotate among each other when a new season arrives.
  • Every win/loss at 10,000+ gives/takes around 150 instead of the usual 30.
  • Every season resets your trophy amount from 10,000 to 12,000 , depending on where you were by the end of the season.
  • Reaching 13,500 grants you Season Badge 1, while reaching 15,000 grants you Season Badge 2.

Path of Legend Changes

  • Starting from 7/7/2025, Path of Legends (renamed to Ranked) will be unlocked by either getting 15,000 this season, granting you the Ranked Ticket, or reaching Champion League the previous season, granting you the Master Ticket.
  • Challenger 1-3 Leagues and the level cap were removed.
  • The rewards were also tweaked.
  • To accommodate those changes, the requirement for this season's Ranked was only reaching Master I.

Gamemode Switcher

  • The Events tab (the far right tab) is now temporarily, and game modes present in there were added to the main screen.
  • Because of this change, Global Tournaments and Classic 2v2 are temporarily disabled.
  • The order of the Gamemodes are as following: Trophy Road, Merge Tactics, the week's Event, Ranked, the weekend's Challenge, Classic 1v1, Classic Challenge, Mega Draft Challenge, and Grand Challenge.

Challenges Changes

  • Challenges were also moved from the Events tab to the main screen Gamemode Switcher.
  • Rewards now come after every win, instead of in a chest at the end.
  • The Book of Cards and badges for each Challenge are temporarily disabled.

Rewards Changes

  • Giant Chest:
    • give more gold and a mix of Epic, Legendary and Champion cards
    • but no Wild Cards.
  • Magical Chest:
    • give more cards and gold
    • but less Epic, Legendary and Champion cards.
  • Lightning Chest:
    • gives more cards and gold
    • but no Wild Cards.
  • The second step of the second Mastery task of Champion cards grant you less Gems (from 300 to 100 ). Those gems were added to the Trophy Road.
  • Bonus Rewards now only give gold.

Other Changes and Bug Fixes

  • Badges now have a new design.
  • Elixir Spectating is disabled in: Ranked, Global Tournaments, Friend List Friendly Battles, and Clan Friendly Battles (minus Leaders, Co-Leaders, and Elders).
  • Cards can now be sorted alphabetically.
  • Evolution filter now shows the card's Evolved art.
  • Skeleton Barrel now has a screen shake + hit Visual Effect for death damage.
  • Fire Spirit got updated Visual Effects and a new card render.
  • Fisherman now grabs Mega Knight mid-jump.
  • Cannon Cart no longer re-targets when switching states at below 50% HP.
  • Goblin Hut stops spawning Goblins if a Troop goes invisible nearby.
  • Enemy Goblin Hut Star Level visual fixed.
  • Tornado's in-game preview now shows correct stats.
  • Goblin Giant's backpack Spear Goblins no longer get wrongly enhanced by Rune Giant.
  • Other stability and minor crash fixes.

2025 Quarter 1 Update (31/3/2025)

Removal of Chest Queue, Daily Tasks, Banner Boxes and Season Shop

  • Chests and Chest Keys will be removed from battle victory rewards.
  • Instead, every day, you will get:
    • 3/4 Lucky Drops for the first 3/4 battle wins, with the first one generally being a 2-Star Lucky Drop.
    • Either Gold (35% chance), Common cards, (30% chance) Rare cards (30% chance) or Epic cards (5% chance) for the first 3 to 25 battle wins. The amount of Gold/cards given to you depends on your Trophies.
    • Note: The placement of the 2-star lucky drop and the amount of lucky drops/rewards depends on the player, as it's being tested
    • 5 Bonus Crowns for the first 3 battle wins (15 crowns total).
    • These rewards reset daily.
    • Note: any unopened Chests will be opened, and any Chest Keys will be converted to Gold.
  • Daily Tasks and Banner Boxes are being removed, with Banner Tokens being converted to Gold.
    • The 3rd Card Mastery rewards for available cards are changed to 6,000, 8,000 and 10,000 Gold instead.
  • Starting from the April Season, the Season Shop will also be removed
  • The rewards geting moved to Pass Royale and Supercell-hosted events.
    • This Season will still have the Season Shop and Season Tokens available.

Changes to Pass Royale, Lucky Drops, and Pathfinding

  • Pass Royale rewards are being changed for both the Free Pass and the Diamond Pass.
  • Changed the probabilities of Lucky Drops getting upgraded. There is a higher chance of getting new Cards from them, while Tower Troop cards were added to the pool of possible rewards.
  • Troop Pathfinding changed: troops are less likely to prioritize lanes and will now see and avoid buildings.

Card Balancing

  • Rage: increases Executioner and Ram Rider’s Hit Speed.
  • All troop stats have now been defined with Common Rarity as the base, solving many level scaling inconsistencies.
  • The Goblin Brawler's hitpoints have been decreased by 9%.

Quality of Life and Bug Fixes

  • Daily Win Streaks repurposed for Player Profile decoration.
  • Added Play Again button.
  • New button to customize your Tower Skin, Emote deck and Battle Banner on the deck selection screen.
  • Lucky Drops open faster.
  • You can now copy links to a private Tournament.
  • Hoggy Bank moved to the Shop.
  • 2v2 friend request pop-ups no longer close if your teammate leves the chat.
  • Latency improved.
  • All Cards that spawn in groups of 3 or more troops now correctly mirror their deploy formation depending on the side of the arena they are deployed in.
  • Fixed various cases where Evolved Hunter would not net other Troops.
  • Fixed air troops not getting grounded by Evolved Hunter’s net.
  • Fixed various cases of Troops getting visually stuck in the air or on the ground.
  • Fixed z-axis issues for ground troops, which were able to cross the river after being knocked up by Evolved Mega Knight.
  • Fixed Electro Giant not always being knocked back when hit by Evolved Mega Knight.
  • Fixed various issues related to Rune Giant’s Enchantment Damage.
  • Fixed various issues related Monk’s Pensive Protection Ability.
  • Fixed missing Card Evolution Diamond indicator for various troops.
  • Fixed 2nd-stage Troops not spawning after being buffed by Royal Chef.
  • Royal Chef’s Pancake can now hit dashing units and Mighty Miner when underground.
  • Rune Giant can no longer enchant Troops while she is captured by an Evolved Goblin Cage.
  • Evolved Electro Dragon enchanted by Rune Giant now deals bonus damage every third attack, rather than every third lightning bounce.

  • Evolved Hunter's net can now target Air Troops directly above.

Lucky Drops 2.0 Update (2/10/2024)

Daily Tasks Rework

  • There will be 5 Tasks instead of 3. The rewards have been changed to:
    • Log In: 1-Star Lucky Drop.
    • Play a Battle: 5 Crowns.
    • Win 6 Crowns: 1-Star Lucky Drop.
    • Win 12 Crowns: 10 Crowns.
    • Win 3 Battles: 2-Star Lucky Drop.
    • Completing the Daily Tasks multiple Days in a row awards you with an extra 1-Star Lucky Drop for each completed day. This Lucky Drop can have up to 3 more spins.

Lucky Drops 2.0

  • Lucky Drops now are based on Stars (1-5 Stars) instead of Rarity (Common, Rare, Epic and Legendary).
  • Some Lucky Drops can start at 2, 3 and even 4 Stars.
  • The Daily Tasks Bonus Lucky Drop has up to 3 bonus spins.
  • The rewards are:
    • 1-Star Lucky Drop: Common Cards, Rare Cards, Epic Cards, Gold.
    • 2-Star Lucky Drop: Common Cards, Rare Cards, Epic Cards, Legendary Cards, Champion Cards, Gold, Banner Item.
    • 3-Star Lucky Drop: Common Cards, Rare Cards, Epic Cards, More Legendary Cards, Champion Cards, Common Wild Cards, Rare Wild Cards, Epic Wild Cards, Legendary Wild Cards, Champion Wild Cards, Gold, Emote.
    • 4-Star Lucky Drop: Common Cards, Rare Cards, Epic Cards, Legendary Cards, Champion Cards, More Common Wild Cards, Rare Wild Cards, Epic Wild Cards, Legendary Wild Cards, Champion Wild Cards, Gold, Elite Wild Cards, Wild Shard.
    • 5-Star Lucky Drop: Elite Wild Cards, CommonBook of Cards, Rare Book of Cards, Epic Book of Cards, Legendary Book of Cards, Book of Books, Full Card Evolution.
    • Amount of items given and chance can be checked by clicking here.

Pass Royale 3.0

  • Gold Pass has been removed (only Free and Diamond Passes stay).
  • There are only 60 Steps (785 Crowns total), but there are now rewards in every step for both Free and Diamond passes.
  • Lucky Drops have been added to both Free and Diamond Passes.
  • The seasonal Animated Banner is now at the Free Pass. The seasonal Emote and King Tower skin are still in the Diamond Pass.
  • Added a Wild Shard to the 60th Free Pass tier
  • Diamond rewards have been changed a bit
  • Lucky Drops Bonus Bank added: amount of Crowns required for a Lucky Drop increases with each unlock.

Other Changes & Bug Fixes

  • Boost Potion duration increased to 3 hours (from 1 hour).
  • Second Evolution slot is moved to King Level 30 (from King Level 54).
  • Added option to report clans and descriptions.
  • New ’Selected Deck’ indicator in the homescreen, next to the Battle button. It doubles as a shortcut to edit your deck.
  • Royal Ghost & Battle Healer: Affected by Earthquake's Damage and Slow Effect and Evolved Royal Giant's Pushback Effect.
  • Fixed Death Damage damaging Crown Towers during Tiebreaker stage.
  • Fixed Void hitting troops outside its radius.
  • Fixed Evolved Goblin Drill spawning Goblins while underground.
  • Fixed Goblin Drill sometimes pushing other troops when underground.
  • Fixed Evolved Battle Ram not damaging large troops.
  • Various fixes related to Evolved Goblin Cage.

Goblin World Update (17/6/2024)

Goblin Queen's Journey

  • The Goblin Queen's Journey is a new temporary game mode added alongside the Trophy Road and the Path of Legends. The highest bonus reward is at 3,400 Goblin Trophies, but there is no cap on Goblin Trophies.
  • Your Goblin Trophies and Arena will be shown on your profile.
  • There will be 4 arenas that unlock different cards and have a Card Level and Card Evolution slot cap. Every time you get to a new arena, you will get a Chest Speed Up Boost.
    • For Gold Mines (Goblins 1, 0-999 trophies) the cap is Level 9 and no Evolution slots are available.
    • For Mud Pit (Goblins 2, 1000-1999 trophies) the cap is Level 11 and 1 Evolution slot is available.
    • For Scrap Yard (Goblins 3, 2000-2999 trophies) the cap is Level 13 and 1 Evolution slot is available.
    • For Ancestral Palace (Goblins 4, 3000+ trophies) the cap is Level 15 and 2 Evolution slots are available.
  • The only tower troop available inside the Goblin Queen’s Journey is the Baby Goblins, having the same stats as Tower Princess. This mode will also changes the King Tower to the Goblin Queen Tower (same stats as the King Tower, but has a special ability (when combined with the Baby Goblins) after spending 20 Elixir on Goblin cards).
  • New temporary Chests were added to the game, giving Gold and Goblin cards. However, they are only available inside the Goblin Queen’s Journey.

Lucky Drops Update (18/3/2024)

Daily Tasks and Lucky Drops:

  • The 3 Daily Tasks will be changed, and will be the same every day. The tasks are:
    • Play 1 Battle.
    • Earn 10 Crowns From Battles.
    • Win 3 Battles.
  • The rewards will be changed to 3 crowns, 3 crowns and a Lucky Box (removing Banner Tokens, XP, and the Silver/Gold Chests)
  • Each Lucky Box starts at Common rarity, and has 3 attempts to upgrade to a higher rarity (36.7% to stay as a Common, 49% to upgrade into a Rare, 12.7% to upgrade into an Epic and 1.6% to upgrade into a Legendary).
  • Some of the rewards in the Lucky Drops will scale in arenas (maxes at Arena 15, 5000 trophies)
  • The Lucky Drops will give many different rewards depending on the rarity. Those are, accounting Arena 15:
    • A Common (36.7%) Lucky Drop will give: 1.500 Gold (30%), 20 Common Wild Cards (30%), 10 Rare Wild Cards (30%), or 5 Epic Wild Cards (10%).
    • A Rare Lucky Drop (49%) will give: 7.500 Gold (25%), 200 Common Wild Cards (25%), 50 Rare Wild Cards (25%), 20 Epic Wild Cards (10%), 1 Legendary Wild Card (10%), or 1 Champion Wild Card (5%).
    • An Epic Lucky Drop (12.7%) will give: 1 Common Book of Cards (12%), 1 Rare Book of Cards (11%), 1 Epic Book of Cards (7%), 5 Legendary Wild Cards (20%), 3 Champion wild cards (20%), 1 Evolution Wild Shard (10%), or 7.500 Elite Wild Cards (20%).
    • A Legendary Lucky Drop (1.6%) will give: 1 Legendary Book of Cards (33,33%), 1 Book of Books (33,33%), or 50.000 Elite wild cards (33,33%).
  • Magic items from Lucky Drops will go over the inventory limits.

Deck UI Changes

  • Copying and pasting decks now includes the Tower Troop.
  • Added a new button to switch between ascending and descending order.
  • Editing the deck can be done by just tapping on 1 of the 8 cards (compared to pressing "Edit Deck"). To go out, just tap the selected card or switch to a different deck slot.

  • The Tower Troop Level is capped by your King Tower level.

Card Evolution Update (19/6/2023)

Elite Level & King Level

  • Level 15 is coming in the form of Elite Level.
  • You upgrade your cards with Elite Wild Cards. Every Level 15 upgrade costs 50.000 Elite Wild Cards and no Gold, regardless of rarity.
  • You get Elite Wild Cards when your cards overflow. Each rarity gives different amount of Elite Wild Cards.
  • You can also convert your Magic Items for Elite Wild Cards if all cards of said rarity are at Level 14.
  • You can have up to 400.000 Elite Wild Cards at once.
  • The King Level can go up to Level 70.
  • The Crown Tower Level gets increased to Level 15 at King Level 54.

Card Evolution

  • Evolutions are a way to upgrade your troops and improve their stats.
  • You need to cycle your troop a few times before you get your evolution.
  • To unlock the evolution, you need to get 6 Evolution Shards, either Wild Shards, or Evolution Shards specifically for that troop.
  • You get Evolution shards in: Pass Royale (King Level 7), Season Shop (King Level 8), Special Event Challenges, Shop, Path of Legends and Level up Chest (after King Level 50, every other Level up Chest will have Evolution Shards).
  • You also need to place the card in the Evolution slot (unlocks at King Level 7).
  • Once the evolution is unlocked, additional shards will be converted to cards (conversion depends on rarity).
  • You cannot use evolutions in: Classic Challenge, Grand Challenge and Mega Draft.

New Evolutions

  • 4 new Evolutions: Barbarians, Skeletons, Royal Giant, and Firecracker.

Other Changes and Improvements

  • 3 new Arenas (Boot Camp, Clash Fest and PANCAKES!) added to Trophy Road, raising the Trophy cap to 9,000.
  • The third Card Mastery Level in the second task will be changed to Gold (amount depend on rarity) from 300 or 450 gems.
  • You can earn Crowns and Chests from the Event tab.
  • The Play Again button is added back to 2v2.
  • Most Chests will get their Gold tripled.
  • 6 cards are getting a third task in the Card Mastery. These are: Royal Giant, Battle Ram, Battle Healer, Electro Wizard, Balloon and Musketeer.
  • The Events tab will be highlighted if there is a new Event Challenge.
  • The Events tab will auto-scroll to a new Event Challenge the first time it is available.
  • Changed Events tab UI so that Event Challenges are more visible.
  • Unclaimed Pass Royale rewards from the previous Season can be claimed in the current Season.

March (3) 2023

Losers Update (27/3/2023)

Season Tokens and Season Shop

  • Season Tokens are a new currency which you can use in the Season Shop.
  • You get Season Tokens from events, Pass Royale & Shop.
  • The Season Shop resets every season and has a variety of rewards in it (like Emotes, Battle Banners, Gold, Magic Items and more).
  • At the end of the season, the Season Tokens will be converted to Gold.

Events Tab Revamp

  • In the event tab, you can earn Season Tokens (50 per Crown Tower defended, 100 per Crown Tower destroyed, 1 per Elixir spent & a 1.5 multiplier on victory).
  • There is a Season Token daily gain cap at 1,000, however you can spend Gems (price increases after each purchase, resets every day) to increase the cap by 1,000 (max 8,000). If you spend Gems to increase the cap once, you will get a x2 multiplier for the day.
  • Party mode is moved here and no longer awards Chests, Crowns and Victory Gold.
  • All matches in the Events use Friendly Rules.
  • Play Events as much as you want.
  • Grand Challenge cost and rewards are halved, and the Mega Draft Challenge is taking its place.

Pass Royale Revamp

  • You can now earn up to 6 crowns per match (1 per Crown Tower destroyed and 1 per Crown Tower defended).
  • Pass Royale is now longer, having 121 tiers, instead of 35.
  • Bonus Bank has been removed.
  • Pass Royale is divided to 3 tiers: Free Tier, Gold Tier, and Diamond Tier (can upgrade from Gold to Diamond mid-season).
    • In the Free Tier, you are getting: Season Tokens, Crown Chests and Gold Crates.
    • In the Gold Tier, you are getting: Wild Cards, Plentiful Gold Crates, a Tower Skin, an Emote, Chest Keys and perks (gold name, Clan gift, automatic chest unlock and unlimited re-entries/continues for Special Event Challenges), as well as everything from previous tiers.
    • In the Diamond Tier, you are getting: Gems, Overflowing Gold Crates, Giant Chests, Magical Chests, a Royal Wild Chest, a Champion card, an animated Battle Banner and an upgraded clan gift, as well as everything from previous tiers.

Miscellaneous, Bug Fixes and Improvements

  • Path of Legends got a new Arena.
  • Fixed a crash when sending Emotes in 2v2 post-Battle screen.
  • Updated Royal Tournament description incorrectly claiming that you can reset losses.
  • Emotes sent after Battle ends now add progress to the 'Use Emote' Daily Task.
  • Stone steps in Path of Legends now don’t break when a Battle ends in a tie.
  • Fixed an issue where a player opponent could not hear the opponent’s Champion Ability sound effects.
  • Fixed a pathfinding issue related to Golem's sight range.
  • Fixed an issue where Arrows did x2 Damage to King Towers in 2v2.
  • Improved The Log and Barbarian Barrel collision detection.
  • Added missing 'Years Played' Badges.
  • Fixed the indicator in the "use Wild Card" screen.
  • Fixed an issue where the Challenger I badge appeared in the clan info screen for players that did not unlock Path of Legends.
  • Fixed a Crash when opening a queued chest after launching the game.
  • Fixed an issue where the Path of Legends leaderboard failed to load after collecting rewards.
  • Fixed an issue where the Elixir Multiplier was not displayed in replays.
  • Increased Monk reflection radius for Fireball and Giant Snowball.

2022 Quarter 3 Update (26/10/2022)

King Level Rework + Champions Unlock

  • King Level now go up to Level 50.
  • The Level-up Chests are smaller, but you get more (50 compared to 14).
  • The Crown Tower Level will still be capped at Level 14.
  • You now unlock Champion Cards from Arenas and their Chests.

Trophy Road

  • In Trophy Road, there are 6 new Arenas (up to Arena 20 at 7,500 trophies). These arenas are: Miner's Mine, Executioner's Kitchen, Royal Crypt, Silent Sanctuary, & Dragon Spa.
  • Besides the Trophy requirement, there is also going to be a King Level requirement.
  • It will not reset, and you can't go higher than 7,500 Trophies.

Path of Legends

  • You can now switch in between Trophy Road & Path of Legends.
  • Path of Legends unlocks at Arena 15 (5,000 trophies).
  • There are 10 Leagues, each having a Level cap.
  • Every time you win, you go up a step. Every time you lose, you go down a step.
  • There are golden steps, where you can't drop down (like a checkpoint). The higher the League, the less golden steps.
  • After Ultimate Champion, there are no steps. Instead, there are player ratings.
  • You will be reset to Challenger 1 after the Season ends. However, the higher League you were before the reset, the higher the step multiplier at the next season.

Daily Tasks

  • Each day, you have 3 tasks. You get a small reward from completing each.
  • You can get a daily bonus if you complete all 3 tasks.
  • Doing it 7 days in a row unlocks you a weekly bonus.

New Cards

  • 1 New Legendary card: Phoenix.
  • 1 New Champion card: Monk.

Hoggy Bank

  • Hoggy Bank is a new premium feature that will cost money to unlock. It will appear on the home screen from time to time and will hold either Gems or Gold.
  • After purchasing the Hoggy Bank, the bank will enable you to receive additional Gold or Gems (depending on the type that you have purchased) that will be stored in the Hoggy Bank.
  • Additionally, during the time period that the Hoggy Bank is active, there will be additional milestones that you can complete and then be able to smash the bank to empty the bank and reap the reward!

Card Balancing

  • Knight: Hitpoints increased by 3%.
  • Goblins:
    • Count increased to 4 (from 3)
    • (affects Goblin Gang, Goblin Barrel, Goblin Drill) First Attack Period increased to 0.4 seconds (from 0.2 seconds).
  • Mirror: Greyed out (not playable) after playing a Champion (from skipping the Champion).

Miscellaneous

  • New Chest: Champion Chest.
  • New Magic Item: Champion Wild Card.
  • The chest cycle has been changed to this cycle.
  • The player profile will be changed to this.
  • All of the cards have been re-arranged.

  • Deck Explorer to more easily find new decks.

Summer 2022 Update (27/6/2022)

Battle Banners

  • Banners are something you can design.
  • The Banner has 3 elements:
    • Frame (background).
    • Decoration (foreground).
    • Badges (up to 3 can be selected).
  • The Banners can appear in your profile & in battle before it starts.
  • You can unlock Banner parts in the Banner Box.
    • The Banner Box can be accessed directly from the home screen.
    • The Banner Box cost 100 Banner Tokens or Gems (starts at 50 & goes up by 50 with each Gem purchase, price resets after every season) & gives 1 Banner element.

Profile Redesign

  • Your Battle Banner is visible and can be tapped to access your Player Profile.
  • You can enter your Battle Log (only on your own profile).
  • You can chose up to 8 badges to show. If you want to see them all, click on "Show Collection".
  • Battle Deck now shows the latest deck played by the player.
  • The rest (League, Stats and Challenge Stats) are the same as normal.
  • The Pass Royale Banner has been moved and resized.

New Badges

  • Win Clan War matches. 8 upgrades (10, 25, 50, 100, 250, 500, 1000, 2500).
  • Donate cards. Progress depend on rarity (Common = 1 card, Rare & Epic= 10 cards). 8 upgrades (100, 500, 1000, 5000, 10000, 25000, 50000, 100000).
  • Collect/upgrade cards. The progress is the sum of all of the cards' Levels. 8 upgrades (100, 200, 400, 600, 800, 1000, 1200).
  • Collect Battle Banner Items. 8 upgrades (15, 30, 50, 100, 150, 200, 300, 400).
  • Win 2v2 battles. 7 upgrades (10, 25, 50, 100, 200, 500, 1000).
  • Collect Emotes. 8 upgrades (0, 25, 50, 100, 150, 200, 250, 300).
  • Be a Supercell Creator.
  • Watch the credits to the end.

Other Changes

  • 10 cards are getting 3 more levels in the Card Mastery feature. The rewards are: 100, 125 and 150 Banner Tokens.
    • The 10 cards are: Arrows, Earthquake, Electro Spirit, Mega Knight, Mortar, P.E.K.K.A, Princess, The Log, Wall Breakers, Wizard.
  • You can play duels outside of Clan Wars. The duel deck slots are accessible via a toggle button at your deck slot panel.
  • There are 2 modes for this:
    • Duel: Best of 3, where you chose a deck before each round. You can not play the same deck 2 times
    • Ban Pick Duel: Best of 1, where you can first see the opponent's 4 decks & ban 2 of their decks. Then, you have to choose 1 of your remaining 2 decks to play.
  • There is a slider for music and sound effects.
  • The Trader has been moved to the Shop. You can also reroll both "Give" and "Get" and trade as many times as you want (given you have enough Trade Tokens/rerolls).

Quality of Life changes

  • Mastery tasks are now faster & you can skip it by swiping up.
  • There’s now a delete deck button in Special Challenges.
  • In Special Challenges, your last deck will be remembered (compared to deleted & you having to build it again).
  • Season Pass gift limit increased from 10 to 20.

Miscellaneous & Bug Fixes

  • AI and bots improvements.

  • Fixed iOS native copy option removing the URL from the "invite to clan" message.
  • Fixed deck builder behaving erratically if the user switched decks in the middle of editing.
  • Fixed personal best scores displaying incorrectly on some Player Profiles.
  • Fixed players sometimes being awarded a Chest that is not from their Arena.
  • Fixed decks showing incorrectly when skipping past the 'Pick' phase in a Draft replay.
  • Star Levels are now hidden when viewing card info screens from the Clan UI.
  • Removed the ability to upgrade your own cards when viewing a Clanmate's cards.
  • Removed Trophy values from the spectator view.
  • Removed the ability to tap on the 'Clan' button in the Player Profile of a player who does not belong to a Clan.
  • Implemented a change to Legendary Chests when the player has not yet reached an Arena that unlocks Legendary Cards.
  • Added a number of Challenge events to the list of modes that can level up Badges.
  • Numerous UI improvements (making things look pretty).
