Champions Update (27/10/2021)

King Level 14

  • Cards and Crown Towers can now be upgraded to Level 14.
  • Experience requirements for certain King Levels have been reduced:
    • The upgrade from King Level 13 to 14 costs the same amount of EXP as the old Level 12 to 13 upgrade.
    • King Level 13 players gained further EXP based on their card upgrades and donations after reaching Level 13.
  • Card requirements for certain levels have been reduced.
  • Players who previously upgraded these card rarities at these levels were compensated with the card difference between the old and new values. For example, a Level 12 Common Card before the update received 500 more copies after the update (2000 - 1500).
  • Gold requirements for certain levels have been reduced.
  • Upgrading from Level 13 to 14 costs the same amount of Cards and Gold as the old Level 12 to 13 upgrade.

Champions

  • Champion is a new rarity, unlocked at King Level 14.
  • There can be only 1 Champion card in your deck and in play.
  • There are 3 Champion cards. Those are: Skeleton King, Archer Queen & Golden Knight.
  • For a more detailed analysis, see the page for Champion cards in general.

Star Points

  • Star Points can now be spent starting from King Level 6.
  • Star Points now accumulate from King Level 1. As a result, Star Points have been separated from EXP, though they are still gained at the same rate in the same manner.
  • Star Levels now unlock based on a card's level:
    • Star Level 1 unlocks for Cards at Level 7.
    • Star Level 2 unlocks for Cards at Level 10.
    • Star Level 3 unlocks for Cards at Level 13.
  • The cost to upgrade a Star Level has been decreased.
  • During a card's preview you may click on the top left to show the card at Star Levels 1, 2 and 3.

King's Journey

  • King's Journey is a progression road based on Experience (like Trophy Road), but for your King Level.
  • Each time you unlock a new King Level, you will get a Level-Up Chest. This can only be obtained here.
  • At King Level 14, the Level-Up Chest will have a guaranteed Champion card.
  • When the update went live, Level-Up Chests prior to a player's King Level were able to receive those Level-Up Chests.

Tournaments

  • The level cap is increased to Level 11 due to the addition of Champion cards.
  • All players joining Classic & Grand Challenges, Special Challenges & Global Tournaments will have every card at Level 11 (even if they don't have the card, or don‘t have the card at Level 11), and will be able to build their own deck from scratch, even with Champion cards.

Miscellaneous

  • There is a new Chest cycle containing Gold Crates, at King Level 10.
  • Legendary Cards appear more often. Champion Card drop rate will be similar to how Legendary Cards used to drop before the update.
  • Players can now rearrange their decks by holding and dragging cards.
  • Increased cooldown time between Emotes used in battle.
  • Increased required Trophies in Clans to reflect changes to Trophy Road.
  • Fixed TV Royale showing the incorrect Arena number.
  • Fixed unintended interaction with Goblin Drill and Clone.
  • Changed the trail for Goblin Drill to make it more distinctive from Miner.
  • Fixed an issue with Replays becoming stuck.
  • Miscellaneous UI fixes.
  • Miscellaneous crash fixes.
  • Miscellaneous minor improvements.

Summer 2021 Update (7/6/2021)

Clan Wars 2 Changes

  • Fame has been renamed to Medals.
  • Boats now move on the river at the end of each day, as opposed to moving immediately upon gaining Medals. Players will move a certain distance based on how many Medals they have in relation to the other clans (1st - 5th).
  • The first 3 days of each Clan War are now "Training Days", where only Gold can be gained from War Tasks, and opposing Clan Boats cannot be attacked. The remaining days are "Battle Days", where Gold and Medals can be gained from War Tasks, and Clan Boats will be vulnerable to attack.

Chest Changes

  • A new type of Chest which can be gained from winning ladder or Party mode matches has been introduced, which will only reward Gold. There are 3 types of Gold Crates, which award different amounts of Gold and have different unlocking times:
    • Gold Crate (3 hours to unlock).
    • Plentiful Gold Crate (8 hours to unlock).
    • Overflowing Gold Crate (12 hours to unlock).
  • Gold Crates will replace Silver and Gold Chests in the Chest Cycle.
  • King Level 11, 12, and 13 will now have different Chest cycles, as opposed to King Levels 1-10.

Trophy Road Changes

  • Leagues now begin at 5,000 Trophies. Between 4,000 and 5,000 Trophies, two new Arenas have been added:
    • Rascal's Hideout (Season 10 Arena - 4,200 Trophies).
    • Serenity Peak (Season 7 Arena - 4,600 trophies).
  • Victory Gold now scales to Arena 14 (Serenity Peak).
  • Chest contents now scale to Arena 15 (Legendary Arena).
  • The amount of Trophies lost when losing a Battle in the Challenger Leagues has been greatly increased.
  • In higher Leagues, the percentage of Trophies lost from the seasonal reset has been reduced:
    • In the Challenger Leagues, Trophy counts will be reset by 50%, the previous amount for all players in Leagues.
    • In the Master Leagues, Trophy counts will be reset by 40%.
    • In the Champion Leagues, Trophy counts will be reset by 30%.
  • The Legendary League, and Trophy Road, now extend to 8,000 Trophies.
  • Trophy Road rewards above 3,300 trophies have been renewed and become available to collect again.
  • Card unlocks have been shuffled around to accommodate for the new Arenas.

Other Changes

  • Players who are at King Level 8 or higher can access 10 Deck slots.
  • Replays can now be fast forwarded and rewinded.
  • Players can now choose to randomize their Tower Skin upon entering a Battle.
  • Trophy Road rewards above 5,000 Trophies now contain more Wild Cards and be more frequent overall.
  • Friendly Battles now have 15 game modes that will always be available.

Bug Fixes

  • A bug which allowed more than 50 members to participate in a Clan War was fixed.
  • A bug related to the Magic Coin and trades was fixed. An exploit which allowed players to receive Card overflow Gold upon cancelling a trade was removed.
  • A bug where a card's deployment would lag if it was played as soon as it was dealt to the player's hand was fixed.
  • Players are now able spectate Supercell ID friends.
  • Fixed some issues related to Fisherman.
  • Bandit’s dash no longer continues after the timer reaches zero.
  • The strike icon from Pass Royale was removed.
  • Fixed missing Mirror deployment animation.
  • Minor improvements were made to the localization and UI.

2021 Quarter 1 Update (30/3/2021)

Magic Items

  • A new category of items has been introduced, allowing players to upgrade cards more quickly as well as have more choice over which cards they receive. They are as follows:
  • Wild Card - comes in the four card rarities. These can be converted into any card of its rarity that the player owns. When opening a Chest above Arena 4, there is a chance that the player will receive a Wild Card in lieu of a regular card.
  • Book of Cards - instantly gives the player the amount of cards needed to upgrade a card to its next Level. Like Wild Cards, these come in four rarities. There is also a "Book of Books", which can be used for any card rarity.
  • Magic Coin - allows the player to upgrade a card to its next level without spending any of their current Gold.
  • Chest Key - allows the player to immediately open a chest won via the ladder, as opposed to having to spend Gems.
  • Magic Items are available via Chests, Trophy Road, paid offers in the Shop, Special Challenges, and Pass Royale (note that not all Magic Items are available through all methods).
  • Wild Card information has been added to the Shop chest, Chest slot, Chest content, and Shop confirm pop-ups.

Clan Wars 2 and UI changes

  • Leaders and Co-leaders can now 'nudge' players to remind them to do their battles!
  • "Decks Remaining Today" is now visible on the UI.
  • War deck cooldowns are synchronized with each individual Clan’s war week start. There is no longer a delay where some Clans can use an ‘extra set’ of War Deck attacks before the War Decks reset for everyone.
  • Fame rewards have been simplified - Card Levels will no longer impact the amount of Fame gained from performing River Tasks.
  • The Battle Deck UI has been updated.
  • The context menu for Battle Decks has been updated - The "Magic" button will be available, which was previously only available in War Decks.
  • Emotes and Tower Skins now have separate sections, with Magic Items receiving their own section.

  • Mother Witch:

    • Attack Period decreased to 1.1 seconds (from 1.2 seconds)
    • First Attack Period decreased to 0.4 seconds (from 0.5 seconds).
  • Witch: Range increased to 5.5 tiles (from 5 tiles).
  • Three Musketeers: Deployment Time decreased to 1 second (from 2 seconds).
  • Elite Barbarians:
    • Attack Period decreased to 1.4 seconds (from 1.5 seconds)

  • Zappies: First Attack Period increased to 1.1 seconds (from 0.9 seconds).

Maintenance Break (4/12/2020)

  • No more decks with less than 8 cards.
  • Updated visuals of the Electro Tower, Clan War Bastion, and Mega Knight Bastion to look smaller, so that spells would no longer be misplayed on them.
  • Supercell ID friends are now available for more countries.
  • The amount of Trophies lost upon a loss have been increased overall, with the increases tapering off the closer one gets to the 6,000 Trophy mark. At Arena 4 or above, all players now lose as much Trophies from losses as they gain from victories.

November (11) 2020

Maintenance Break (24/11/2020)

  • Fixed a bug where some members of a Clan could not get a Chest upon finishing the River Race.

Maintenance Break (19/11/2020)

  • Fixed a bug that caused the game to crash related to using Lightning on an Electro Giant.

Clan Wars Improvement Update (18/11/2020)

Clan War Changes

  • The reset time of War Decks no longer corresponds to the player's local time zone. All War Decks now refresh at 10AM UTC.
  • The matchmaking between Clans in Clan Wars has been updated to account for overall player skill and activity.
  • Legendary II (beginning at 4,000 Clan Trophies) and Legendary III (beginning at 5,000 Clan Trophies) have been added as further divisions of the Legendary League, with rewards scaling accordingly.
  • The amount of unique participants who can play in a Clan War has been set to 50. Clans also now require a minimum of 10 eligible players to be able to participate in Clan Wars; however, dropping below 10 eligible players will not remove the Clan in the middle of a War.
  • In the final week's River Race, after completing the half-length River Race, regular Duels can no longer be played. The Colosseum has a new visual indicator directing players to Duel there.
  • In the last 3 days of a River Race, all Fame and Repair Points earned will be doubled.
  • A new game mode will rotate in each week, in addition to Duels and Battles.

Interface Changes

  • The Supercell ID menu can now be accessed directly from the drop-down menu on the home screen.
  • If the player has multiple Supercell ID accounts saved on their device, a new button beside the Supercell ID button will appear, allowing them to quickly switch between them.
  • Adding someone as a friend in one Supercell game will automatically add them as friends in other Supercell games, as long as both players are linked to Supercell ID.
  • It is now possible to view what a friend is playing from the Supercell ID friend list and join them directly.
  • A QR code containing a friend link can now be generated and scanned, allowing players to add each other more easily.
  • In the Clan menu, each player's League division and donation count is now displayed.

Card Balancing

  • Electro Giant: Reflected damage now scales with Level.
  • Graveyard: Skeleton Spawn Radius increased to 3-4 tiles (from 3.5-4 tiles).
  • Battle Healer and Royal Ghost: Hovering mechanics altered.
    • They can no longer hover over buildings.
    • They can no longer push air units.
    • When knocked into the river, they will no longer bounce off of it.

Bug Fixes

  • Players will now always receive the correct amount of Gold after Boat Battles and River Race battles.
  • The redirect for a news notification for the Esports tab now works correctly.
  • Pass Royale color codes will now be displayed correctly for spectators in 2v2 Battles.
  • Damaged Boat Defenses will now correctly repair themselves when a new Clan War starts.
  • Fix for friend icons when the friend has no Profile picture
  • General performance improvements and crash fixes.

Version 3.2 - End of November 2019 Update (26/11/2019)

Game Rule Changes

  • All matches can now only go up to five minutes long instead of six. In regular matches, Overtime lasts last for two minutes instead of three, and the final minute has Elixir generate at triple the rate instead of double.
  • Double and Triple Elixir game modes have a simple one-minute reduction on match length.
  • The Sudden Death game mode now lasts five minutes instead of three. The first two minutes have double Elixir generation while the last three minutes have tripled Elixir generation.
  • The Ramp Up game mode increases the Elixir generation multiplier every minute. At the first minute, it is normal, and at the second, it is doubled, going all the way to having quintupled Elixir generation in the final minute of the game.
  • Spawning modes such as Wall Breakers Rush have normal Elixir generation in the first minute, the next two minutes with doubled Elixir generation, and the last two minutes with tripled Elixir generation.

Card Info Screens

  • The card info screens have received a makeover. Tapping the card's "Info" or "Upgrade" button reveals a new pop-up, showing the card's name, an unique vector graphic, Level, rarity, card type, amount of cards obtained, and if the card is able to be upgraded, its Experience gain and upgrade cost. It features an interactive display with three pages. The first page shows a short video of the card in action, displaying what the card is strong against and weak against. The second page has the card's stats. The final page has the card's description.
  • Over time, the card stats will be updated with more in-depth information, such as an area damage radius.
  • Cards without an unique vector graphic will receive one over time.

Miscellaneous Changes

  • Hog Rider, Royal Hogs, Ram Rider, and the Freeze spell are no longer selectable in the deck builder for Mega Touchdown.
  • In 2v2 Touchdown Draft, each player is now guaranteed to receive one 'fast runner' (such as Hog Rider) and one 'big runner' (such as Giant).
  • Trophy Road has been updated so that Royal Hogs, Heal, and Elixir Golem can now be received from the reward nodes from the Arena they are unlocked in.

Bug Fixes

  • Victory Gold rewards are now consistent with the player's current Arena.
  • Death Damage, such as from the Balloon's bomb, are no longer be able to damage Towers during a tiebreaker.
  • Text localization for card info screens has been updated.
  • The information card for Triple Draft has been updated.
  • Fixed a bug where the player would receive a permanent in-game notification after unlocking a Tower skin.
  • Some UI layer sizing issues were fixed.
  • Several crashing issues were fixed.
  • An infamous oversight where a card could be incorrectly selected and play in place of another card has been fixed.
  • Cards are now dealt to the player's hand faster and respond faster. This is dependent on how fast Elixir is being generated.
    • 1x Elixir: 2000ms -> 1000ms
    • 2x Elixir: 1000ms -> 500ms
    • 3x Elixir: 500ms -> 350ms

Version 3.0 - End of September 2019 Update (30/9/2019)

New "Party!" Button

  • The 2v2 button has been moved inside the Party Button's menu. The Party button functions as a hub for several casual modes where players can earn crowns, victory Gold, and Chests, without the risk of losing Trophies, just like how 2v2 works. Aside from the 2v2 mode, the playable special modes will rotate between each other every 48 hours.
  • The matchmaking algorithm for modes in the Party Button is different than regular ladder, factoring in both card Levels and King Tower Levels.

Triple Draft

  • A variation of the existing Draft mode has been introduced in Friendly Battles. Instead of picking one card out of two and giving the other to the opponent four times, the player will pick one out of three cards eight times, with the other two cards being discarded. The player will also be able to see what three cards their opponent can pick from, and vice versa. However, neither player can know for certain what card their opponent picked out of the three cards.

Supercell ID Emote

  • A new Emote is available, exclusive to players who have their account connected to Supercell ID. The emote is the chicken from one of Supercell's other mobile games, Hay Day, clucking.

Tiebreakers

  • A tiebreaker system has been introduced in all modes outside of 1v1 Ladder when a match has ran out of time in Overtime. At the end of the match, all the Towers of each player will rapidly lose health until one is destroyed before the other, making draws extremely rare.

Crown Rush

  • Similar to Gold Rush, Crown Rush is a limited-time event in which players can earn double the crowns from 1v1 Ladder. The amount gained varies based on Arena and League, but can go up to a possible 30 extra obtainable crowns.

Quality of Life Changes

  • Inactive Clan Leaders will now have their Leader role to the longest serving Co-leader. This will happen after 35 days of inactivity (warning messages will be sent 14 days and 3 days before they are rotated). If there is no Co-leader, the Leader role will be given to the longest serving Elder. If there is no Elder, the Leader role will be given to the Member who first joined the clan.
  • At the end of a match, the countdown timer & text is now transparent.

New Star Levels

  • Bomber: Star Level 2.
  • Cannon: Star Level 3.

Version 2.7 - April 2019 Update (15/4/2019)

Introducing… Trophy Road!

  • A brand new way to progress in Clash Royale 1v1 Ladder Battles!
  • Collect rewards as you earn Trophies and progress through the Arenas!
  • The higher your Trophies, the better the rewards! Earn Gems, Gold, Chests, stacks of cards (of different rarities), Trade Tokens AND Emotes on the Trophy Road!
  • Protect your Trophies! Reaching a new Arena activates a Trophy Gate! This means you can’t drop below the Trophies needed for that Arena, or drop to a lower Arena! Once you hit 4,000 Trophies, you will not drop below Legendary Arena’s Trophy Gate of 4,000, but you can drop through League rankings.
  • Activate Chest Speed Up Boosts for 24 hours when reaching a new Arena - unlock those new Arena Chests faster!
  • Set your goals! See your Trophy Progress and what you need to do to get that next reward.
  • New rewards every Season! At the end of each League Season, alongside the Trophy reset, you will also reset your Trophy Road progress from 4,000+. This means that each Season you will be able to earn new rewards throughout! Because of this, we are removing the League Chest, allowing you to instead earn rewards as you progress through a Season.
  • Royal Champion League lands in at 6,600 Trophies, with Ultimate Champion League now starting at 7,000+ trophies!
  • View your friends' progress! Enjoy some healthy competition with your friends & Clan members - view their progress on the Trophy Road!
  • Existing/returning players will unlock ALL Trophy Road rewards - up to their current Trophies - after updating. Nice!

New Cards

  • 2 New Rare cards: Earthquake and Goblin Cage.

New Game Modes!

Mega Deck

  • Increased Elixir generation.
  • Increased Deck size (8 Cards -> 18 Cards).
  • Develop new strategies and ways to defeat your opponent!

Elixir Capture

  • Use Elixir from the Arena to defeat your opponent!
  • Elixir spawns on both bridges, and must be collected by troops!
  • An Elixir Storage in the middle of the Arena gives 2 Elixir when destroyed.
  • The Elixir Storage has two health bars. Whichever side to deplete their own health bar first get the Elixir.
  • Use this extra Elixir to gain an advantage over your opponent!

Dragon Hunt

  • Players hunt an Elixir Egg with two health bars and the first to destroy their own health bar spawns a Dragon for their side!
  • When the Elixir Egg is destroyed, another one spawns after 30 seconds.
  • The spawned Dragon can be either Baby Dragon, Inferno Dragon, or Electro Dragon!

Home Screen (Battle Tab) Changes

  • "Help, I can't find Leaderboards or Training Camp!" We have cleaned up the Battle Tab and rearranged some things. The Battle Tab menu now contains the following: Activity Log, Leaderboards, TV Royale, Training Camp, Tournaments and Settings.

    • Limited Time Game Modes
    • Grand Challenges & Classic Challenges
  • Note: Private Tournaments now live in the Battle Tab menu!

Improvements

Version 2.5 - December 2018 Update (5/12/2018)

Star Points

  • Star Levels give your Max Level cards a fresh new look!

New Card

Global Tournaments

  • Play in all-new GLOBAL tournaments with tons of rewards!
  • Unlock FREE rewards as you get more wins.
  • Use Gems to unlock the BONUS rewards when the tournament ends.
  • Finish at the top of the leaderboard to earn an EXCLUSIVE reward!

Private Tournaments

  • We've revamped the original tournament system (now called "private tournaments").
  • Private tournaments cost 10 Gems to create for any size and duration, but have no rewards - they're just for fun now, ideally with friends!
  • When creating one, you can choose from any game mode and set a King Level/card Level cap!

Challenges

Version 2.3 - Summer 2018 Update (20/6/2018)

New Cards

  • Unlock TWO new cards as the day of the update!
  • 2 New Common Cards: Giant Snowball & Royal Recruits.
  • 1 New Rare Card: Royal Hogs.

New Emotes

  • New Goblin and Princess Emotes are here!
  • Pick new Emotes up from the Shop in a pack and craft your Emote Deck.
  • Supercell will be adding new Emotes regularly.

1v1 Arena Battles Improvements

  • Rearrangement of the unlock order of cards throughout the Arenas for the following reasons:
    • To create Arenas where cards complement each other mechanically.
    • Ensure there are always answers to win conditions within an Arena.
    • Move low use rate, spicy cards to later Arenas.
    • Where possible, match cards thematically to their Arena.
    • Each new Arena will introduce new or unique mechanics.
  • Changed the League Season reset points:
    • Trophies above 4,000 (up to 7,600) will be reduced by 50% - e.g. a player at exactly 5,000 Trophies will be reset to 4,500.
    • This new, more gradual system will give everyone playing 1v1 Arena Battles a better time when the League Season resets each month!
    • 1v1 Arena Battles above 4,000 Trophies will now have 3 minutes Sudden Death.

Clan Wars Improvements

  • Gold rewards DOUBLED (includes War Chest and Victory Gold).
  • Rewatch your Clan's War Day battles.
  • Spectate the enemy Clans' War Day battles (tap "LIVE" on their boat).

  • Copy your War Deck to your Battle Deck.
  • Switching the Collection Day game modes about once per month to keep things fresh!

Improvements

Version 2.0 - Epic Quests Update (9/10/2017)

Quests

  • Take on daily and weekly Quests to earn epic rewards.
  • Rewards include Super Magical and Legendary Chests!

New Game Modes

  • Mirror Battles give you and your opponent the exact same deck.

April (4) 2016

Maintenance Break (11/4/2016)

  • Fixed an issue where some players would not receive Legendary Trophies after the season resetted.

March (3) 2016

Balance Changes (23/3/2016)

  • X-Bow: Range decreased to 12 (from 13).
  • Tesla:
    • Attack Period increased to 0.8 seconds (from 0.7 seconds)
    • Lifetime decreased to 40 seconds (from 60 seconds).
  • Cannon: Lifetime decreased to 30 seconds (from 40 seconds).
  • Princess: Hitpoints decreased by 10%.
  • Ice Wizard: Damage increased by 5%.
  • Prince: Charge Speed decreased by 13%.
  • Dark Prince: Charge Speed decreased by 13%.
  • Valkyrie:
    • Damage increased by 10%
    • Hitpoints increased by 10%.
  • Royal Giant: Damage increased by 20%.
  • Giant: Damage increased by 5%.
  • Rage:
    • Attack Period and Movement Speed increased to 40% (from 35%)
    • Duration decreased to 8 seconds (from 10 seconds).
  • Poison: Damage increased by 5%.
  • Mirror: Mirrored Legendary card Level decreased by 1.
  • Three Musketeers: Cost decreased to 9 Elixir (from 10).
  • Archers: First Attack Period decreased to 0.1 seconds (from 0.2 seconds).
  • Balloon: Hitpoints increased by 5%.
  • Witch: Damage increased by 5%.

Maintenance Break (16/3/2016)

  • Improved clan searching in Asian languages.
  • Miscellaneous bug fixes.

Maintenance Break (5/3/2016)

  • Fixed a server load issue while matchmaking.
  • Players are less likely to encounter the same opponent repeatedly.

Minor Update (3/3/2016)

  • Bug fixes.

Global Launch on iOS and Android (2/3/2016)

  • Available for iOS and Android globally.

Maintenance Break (1/3/2016)

  • Fixed a bug with incorrect Arena numbers (for Arenas 6 and 7) showing for some players.
  • Localization fixes.

February (2) 2016

Maintenance Break (29/2/2016)

  • Fixed in-game inbox.
  • Localization fixes.

Version 1.2 - March 2016 Update (29/2/2016)

New Cards

  • 1 New Common Card: Royal Giant.
  • 1 New Rare Card: Three Musketeers.
  • 2 New Epic Cards: Dark Prince, Poison.
  • New Rarity: Legendary
  • 2 New Legendary Cards: Ice Wizard, Princess.

New Arena, Chests & More

  • Arena: Builder's Workshop (unlocks at 1700 Trophies, moving the Royal Arena to 2000).
  • Chests: Giant Chest and Super Magical Chest.
  • Deck Slots: Save multiple Battle Decks.

Even More New Stuff

  • Training Camp: Opponents scale up to 3500 Trophies.
  • Localization: 14 new in-game languages (French, German, Spanish, Italian, Dutch, Norwegian, Portuguese, Russian, Turkish, Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Arabic).
  • (iOS) 3D Touch: Gives quick card info.

Card Balancing

  • Zap:
    • Damage decreased by 6%
    • 1 second stun added.
  • Giant Skeleton:
    • Hitpoints increased by 11%
    • Death Damage Time increased to 3 seconds (from 1 second).
  • Tesla: Hitpoints decreased by 5%.
  • Rage: Effect falls off after 2 seconds when affected troops leave its area.

Bug Fixes & Other Changes

  • Combat Mechanics: Troops are harder to distract.
    • Troops won't be pulled from their lane as easily by buildings; buildings will need to be positioned a bit closer.
    • Troops won't target and move towards units that attack them from far away.
  • Card Donation: Rare Cards give 10 experience (from 5 experience).
  • Replay Controls: Show and hide replay controls by tapping the screen.
  • Area Damage: Troops and buildings that deal area damage won't stop their attack if their target dies during the attack animation.
  • Mirror: Fixed to correctly cost your previous card +1 Elixir.

Maintenance Break (26/2/2016)

  • Fixed a Google Play account binding issue.

Balance Changes (19/2/2016)

  • Spells: Crown Tower Damage decreased by 20%.
  • Tombstone: Lifetime decreased to 40 seconds (from 60 seconds).
  • Inferno Tower:
    • Hitpoints decreased by 6%
    • Lifetime decreased to 40 seconds (from 45 seconds).
  • Musketeer: Damage increased by 11%.
  • Golem & Golemite: Hitpoints decreased by 5%.
  • Skeletons (affects Tombstone, Skeleton Army, Witch):
    • Hitpoints increased by 11%
    • Damage increased by 11%.
  • Witch: Damage increased by 3%.

Softlaunch on Android (16/2/2016)

  • Available for Android in Canada, Hong Kong, Australia, Sweden, Norway, Denmark, Iceland, Finland and New Zealand.

Chest Rewards & Card Balance (9/2/2016)

Card Balancing

  • Mini P.E.K.K.A.: Hitpoints increased by 3%.
  • Valkyrie: Attack Period decreased to 1.5 seconds (from 1.6 seconds).
  • Giant: Hitpoints increased by 5%.
  • Tombstone: Skeleton Death Spawn Count reduced to 4 (from 6).
  • Mortar: Lifetime increased to 30 seconds (from 20 seconds).
  • Bomb Tower: Attack Period decreased to 1.6 seconds (from 1.7 seconds).
  • Musketeer:
    • Damage decreased by 25%
    • Cost decreased to 4 Elixir (from 5).
  • Tesla: Damage increased by 7%.
  • X-Bow: Deployment Time increased to 5 seconds (from 3 seconds).
  • Zap: Damage increased by 6%.

Other Changes

  • Arena 3-7 Chests: Now contain more Cards and Gold, cost a few more Gems, but have overall better value! (changed on 5/2/2016).

Version 1.1 - February 2016 Update (2/2/2016)

Legendary Arena & Seasons

  • Legendary Arena: Unlocks at 3000 Trophies.
  • Seasons: Every two weeks, players above 3000 Trophies will be reset to 3000 and all deducted Trophies will be awarded as Legend Trophies!

Tournament Rules

  • Tournament Rules: Friendly Battles now use the all-new "Tournament Standard" level caps for truly fair-play matches! The level caps: King & Crown Towers are level 8, Common Cards are level 8, Rare are level 6, Epic are level 3, and overtime lasts for 3 minutes. Have fun organizing your own tournaments!

Card Balancing

  • Arrows: Damage decreased by 4%.
  • Freeze:
    • Radius decreased to 3 (from 4)
    • Duration increased to +0.3 seconds per level (from +0.4 seconds).
  • Wizard: Damage decreased by 7%.
  • Barbarians (affects Barbarian Hut): Hitpoints decreased by 4%.
  • Bomber: Attack Period decreased to 1.9 seconds (from 2 seconds).
  • Golem & Golemite:
    • Damage increased by 43%
    • Death Damage increased by 43%
    • Hitpoints increased by 43%.
  • P.E.K.K.A.:
    • Hitpoints decreased by 13%
    • Cost decreased to 7 Elixir (from 8).
  • X-Bow:
    • Hitpoints decreased by 15%
    • only targets Ground (from Air & Ground).
  • Inferno Tower:
    • Lifetime decreased to 45 seconds (from 60 seconds)
    • Re-Targeting decreased by 0.4 seconds.
  • Cannon:
    • Cost decreased to 3 Elixir (from 6)
    • Range decreased to 6 (from 7)
    • Lifetime decreased to 40 seconds (from 60 seconds)
    • Hitpoints decreased by 55%.
  • Mortar:
    • Cost decreased to 4 Elixir (from 6)
    • Damage decreased by 40%
    • Lifetime decreased to 20 seconds (from 40 seconds)
    • Range decreased to 12 (from 13).
  • Mirror:
    • Mirrored Common Card Level increased by 4
    • Mirrored Rare Card Level increased by 2.
  • Bomb Tower: Attack Period decreased to 1.7 seconds (from 1.8 seconds).
  • Barbarian Hut: Hitpoints increased by 10%.
  • Elixir Collector: Elixir Generation Period decreased to 9.8 seconds (from 9.9 seconds).

Other Changes

  • Battle Cost: Removed the Gold cost for Battles and Friendly Battles.
  • Chest Gold: To keep the Gold economy intact and compensate for the free Battles, chests give slightly less Gold.
  • Death Damage: Balloon, Giant Skeleton and Golem's death damage statistics are now shown on their card info screens.
  • Notifications: Classier in-game notification pop-ups.
  • Local Notifications: New card request available, Crown Chest available, and second Free Chest available notifications.
  • Push Notifications: New "A Clanmate's battle is now featured in TV Royale!" notification.
  • Bugs: Stuck Witches, iMessage issues, and many more fixes.

January (1) 2016

Maintenance Break (13/1/2016)

  • Testing new network technology to make the game more responsive and decrease network lag.
  • Adding notifications for top 500 players when they're matchmaking for over 20 seconds (now informs other players that someone is looking for a match).
  • Adding notifications to let players know when one of their games has made it to TV Royale.
  • Transferring Game Center accounts between devices is now enabled at XP level 2.

The First Update (11/1/2016)

Card Balancing

  • Prince: Hitpoints decreased by 4%.
  • Goblin Barrel: Goblin Level decreased by 1.
  • Witch: Skeleton Level decreased by 1.
  • Mortar: Lifetime decreased to 40 seconds (from 60 seconds).

Other Changes

  • XP required to get from level 8 to 9 increased by 25%.
  • One new replay is published to TV Royale every hour.
  • Bug fixes.

Version 1.0 - Softlaunch on iOS (4/1/2016)

  • Available for iOS in Canada, Hong Kong, Australia, Sweden, Norway, Denmark, Iceland, Finland, and New Zealand.
